
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_accounts.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_orders.filter(F.col("shipping_fee") >= 29).filter(F.col("order_date") >= "2023-11-17").alias("o"),

        "left_semi",
    )
    .select(F.col("a.id"), F.col("a.customer_id"), F.col("a.balance"), F.col("a.opened_date"))
    .orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc(), "id")
```

```sql
WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        CEIL(quantity) AS quantity_whole,
        FLOOR(quantity) AS quantity_whole_2
    FROM inventory
    WHERE quantity >= 234
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.product_id,
        e.quantity,
        e.quantity_whole,
        d.category,
        d.cost,
        d.stock_qty
    FROM valid e
    LEFT JOIN products d
        ON e.product_id = d.id
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        quantity_whole,
        stock_qty,
        quantity * cost AS quantity_times_cost
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE category IS NOT NULL
      AND quantity_whole > 62
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT a.*, b.brand
    FROM base a
    LEFT JOIN products b
        ON a.product_id = b.id
),
base_inventory AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(stock_qty, 0) AS stock_qty_filled,
        COALESCE(quantity_times_cost, 0) AS quantity_times_cost_filled,
        COALESCE(brand, 'N/A') AS brand_filled
    FROM enriched
    WHERE brand IS DISTINCT FROM 'Globex'
      AND brand = 'Acme'
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        quantity_whole,
        stock_qty,
        brand,
        brand_filled,
        LEAD(quantity_times_cost_filled, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity_times_cost, id) AS next_quantity_times_cost_filled,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, brand ORDER BY stock_qty, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_quantity
    FROM base_inventory
)
SELECT
    id,
    quantity_whole,
    stock_qty,
    brand,
    brand_filled,
    cumulative_quantity,
    CASE WHEN brand RLIKE '^(Acme|Globex)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'CORE' END AS brand_zone
FROM metrics
ORDER BY quantity_whole DESC NULLS FIRST, stock_qty;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("quantity") >= 234)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        F.ceil("quantity").alias("quantity_whole"),
        F.floor("quantity").alias("quantity_whole_2"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    valid
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.product_id",
        "e.quantity",
        "e.quantity_whole",
        F.col("d.category"),
        F.col("d.cost"),
        F.col("d.stock_qty"),
    )
)

base = (
    with_dims
    .filter(F.col("category").isNotNull() & (F.col("quantity_whole") > 62))
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "quantity_whole",
        "stock_qty",
        (F.col("quantity") * F.col("cost")).alias("quantity_times_cost"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_products.alias("b"), F.col("a.product_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("b.brand"))
)

base_inventory = (
    enriched
    .filter((~F.col("brand").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Globex"))) & (F.col("brand") == "Acme"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("stock_qty", F.lit(0)).alias("stock_qty_filled"),
        F.coalesce("quantity_times_cost", F.lit(0)).alias("quantity_times_cost_filled"),
        F.coalesce("brand", F.lit("N/A")).alias("brand_filled"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    base_inventory
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity_whole",
        "stock_qty",
        "brand",
        "brand_filled",
        F.lead("quantity_times_cost_filled", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity_times_cost", "id")).alias("next_quantity_times_cost_filled"),
        F.sum("quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id", "brand").orderBy("stock_qty", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_quantity"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity_whole",
        "stock_qty",
        "brand",
        "brand_filled",
        "cumulative_quantity",
        F.when(F.col("brand").rlike("^(Acme|Globex)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("CORE").alias("brand_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("quantity_whole").desc_nulls_first(), "stock_qty")
)
```

```sql
select id, method, amount AS payment_amount, paid_at AS payment_paid_at
from payments p
where not exists (
    select 1
    from orders o
    where p.order_id = o.id
      and o.order_date > '2025-05-04'
      and datediff(o.order_date, p.paid_at) <= 1
      and o.shipping_fee > 23
)
  and not exists (
    select null
    from order_items oi
    where oi.order_id = p.order_id
      and oi.unit_price < p.amount
      and quantity < 8
      and oi.unit_price > 206
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_payments.alias("p")
    .join(
        df_orders.filter(F.col("shipping_fee") > 23).filter(F.col("order_date") > "2025-05-04").alias("o"),
        (F.col("p.order_id") == F.col("o.id"))
        & (F.datediff(F.col("o.order_date"), F.col("p.paid_at")) <= 1),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .join(
        df_order_items.filter(F.col("unit_price") > 206).filter(F.col("quantity") < 8).alias("oi"),
        (F.col("oi.order_id") == F.col("p.order_id")) & (F.col("oi.unit_price") < F.col("p.amount")),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .select(
        F.col("p.id"),
        F.col("p.method"),
        F.col("p.amount").alias("payment_amount"),
        F.col("p.paid_at").alias("payment_paid_at"),
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        event_type,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_duration_sec,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(event_time), page ORDER BY duration_sec, id) AS duration_sec_bucket
    FROM web_events
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type, page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_duration_sec,
        AVG(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type, page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_duration_sec,
        MIN(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type, page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_duration_sec
    FROM enriched
    WHERE duration_sec = 147
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        event_type,
        event_time,
        duration_sec_bucket
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY running_sum_duration_sec, id) = 1
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR event_time > LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id) + INTERVAL 60 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM ranked
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        event_type,
        event_time,
        duration_sec_bucket,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM gaps
),
gaps_2 AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR event_time > LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id) + INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM islands
),
islands_web_events AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM gaps_2
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN island_id >= 9 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS island_id_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', event_time) AS week_start,
    COUNT_IF(event_type = 'click') AS click_events,
    MAX(event_time) AS last_event_time,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(island_id, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS island_id_quartiles,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN island_id >= 9 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END ORDER BY COUNT_IF(event_type = 'click') DESC) AS click_events_percent_rank
FROM islands_web_events
GROUP BY CASE WHEN island_id >= 9 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', event_time);
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

enriched = (
    df_web_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        F.sum("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_duration_sec"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("event_time"), "page").orderBy("duration_sec", "id")).alias("duration_sec_bucket"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("duration_sec") == 147)
    .withColumn("running_sum_duration_sec", F.sum("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type", "page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_avg_duration_sec", F.avg("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type", "page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_min_duration_sec", F.min("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type", "page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

ranked = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("running_sum_duration_sec", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "event_type", "event_time", "duration_sec_bucket")
)

gaps = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "event_type",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec_bucket",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

gaps_2 = (
    islands
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands_web_events = gaps_2.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

result = (
    islands_web_events
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("island_id") >= 9, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("island_id_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "event_time").alias("week_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("event_type") == "click").alias("click_events"),
        F.max("event_time").alias("last_event_time"),
        F.percentile_approx("island_id", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("island_id_quartiles"),
    )
    .withColumn("click_events_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("island_id_tier").orderBy(F.col("click_events").desc())))
)
```

```sql
        ROUND(approved_amount / NULLIF(claimed_amount, 0), 3) AS approved_amount_per_claimed_amount
    FROM matched
    WHERE policy_id >= 19
),
without_matches AS (

enriched_policy AS (

    SELECT product_group, adjuster_id, policy_product, approved_amount_per_claimed_amount

) src

)
```

```python
        "c.claim_date",
        "c.claimed_amount",
        "c.adjuster_id",
        "c.approved_amount",
        "p.product",

    )

    .select(

        F.round(F.col("approved_amount") / F.nullif(F.col("claimed_amount"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("approved_amount_per_claimed_amount"),
```

```python
base = (

    .select(

        "price",
        "launch_date",
        "tags",
        "price_rounded",
        F.lower("product_name").alias("product_name_lower"),
        F.date_format("launch_date", "MMM yyyy").alias("launch_date_label"),

metrics = (
```

```sql
    FROM enriched
),

    -- Running and moving aggregates

        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_recent duration_sec_dense_rank,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY last7_avg_event_time_date_year_sum_duration_sec, id) last7_avg_event_time_date_year_sum_duration_sec_bucket,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id) session_id_sum_duration_sec
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY duration_sec DESC NULLS LAST)

    SELECT
```

```sql
    FROM with_gaps
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', started_at_period) AS week_start,
    session_id,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(browser)) AS num_browsers,
    MAX(started_at_period) AS last_started_at_period
```

```sql
    FROM with_gaps
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM islands
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id
    FROM transactions
    WHERE is_flagged
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM islands s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    SELECT
        src.account_id,
        src.amount,
        src.is_flagged,
        src.session_id,
        d.balance,
        d.status
    FROM reconciled src
    LEFT JOIN accounts d
        ON src.account_id = d.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY balance) AS balance_rank
    FROM joined
),
metrics AS (

        session_id,
        balance,
        balance_rank,

        STDDEV_SAMP(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_stddev_samp_balance,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY balance_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) AS balance_rank_cume_dist
    FROM scored
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        balance,
        balance_rank,
        FLOOR(balance_rank_cume_dist) AS balance_rank_cume_dist_whole
    FROM metrics
    WHERE session_id BETWEEN 4 AND 5
)

    CASE WHEN balance_rank >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS balance_rank_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(balance_rank, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS balance_rank_quartiles,
    SUM(balance_rank_cume_dist_whole) AS total_balance_rank_cume_dist_whole
FROM base
GROUP BY CASE WHEN balance_rank >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
```

```python
)

islands = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "is_flagged",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
    )
```

```sql
    SUM(energy_cost) FILTER (WHERE quality IS NOT NULL) AS energy_cost_quality_is_not_null,
```

```python
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_departments.alias("b"), F.col("s.dept_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
```

```sql
        id,
```

```sql
        SUM(rating) OVER (ORDER BY rating ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_rating
    FROM deduped
    WHERE rating BETWEEN 2.1 AND 3.4
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rating_avg_3_prior ASC, id ASC) AS event_seq,

    FROM enriched
),
not_flagged AS (

        COUNT(*) AS row_count,

    FROM not_flagged
    GROUP BY seq_no
)
```

```sql
    FROM sessions
```

```sql
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.browser,
        s.country,
        x.event_time
    FROM base s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.event_time
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.event_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
base_sessions AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(country, 1, 3) AS country_prefix,
        CONCAT_WS('-', browser, country) AS browser_country_key,
        COALESCE(country, 'OTHER') AS country_filled
    FROM with_last
    WHERE country IS NOT NULL
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base_sessions s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND x.session_id IN (15, 23)
        )
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT country, browser
    FROM eligible
    EXCEPT
    SELECT country, browser
    FROM sessions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM eligible s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.country = k.country AND s.browser = k.browser
),
eligible_sessions AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM reconciled s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND x.event_time <= s.event_time
        )
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM eligible_sessions s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events ch

              AND ch.event_type = 'add_to_cart'
        )
)

    id,
    browser,
    event_time,

FROM kept
```

```python
    .withColumn("rating_adjusted", F.round((F.col("rating") * 100), 2))
    .withColumn("city_filled", F.coalesce("city", F.lit("DIRECT")))

    .filter(F.col("rating").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("prev_rating_adjusted", F.lag("rating_adjusted").over(Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy("rating_adjusted", "id")))
```

```sql
        LAG(monthly_fee_int, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(start_date), customer_id ORDER BY start_date ASC, id ASC) AS prev_monthly_fee_int
    FROM valid
    WHERE customer_id IS NULL

ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *

        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY start_date_month_avg_monthly_fee_int DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC) AS latest_rank

        monthly_fee_avg_6,
        prev_monthly_fee_int,

    FROM ranked
    WHERE start_date >= DATE '2023-03-21'

)
-- Multi-level aggregation

    COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'enterprise' THEN 1 END) AS enterprise_count,
    COUNT_IF(plan = 'basic') AS basic_events,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled_rows
FROM valid_subscriptions
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', start_date)
HAVING COUNT_IF(plan = 'basic') >= 1
ORDER BY distinct_customer_ids DESC NULLS LAST;
```

```python
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        F.col("monthly_fee").cast("int").alias("monthly_fee_int"),
        F.substring("plan", 1, 2).alias("plan_prefix"),
    )
)

scored = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("monthly_fee_int").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("start_date"), "plan")).alias("start_date_month_avg_monthly_fee_int"),
        F.avg("monthly_fee").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "start_date"), "status").orderBy("monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("monthly_fee_avg_6"),
        F.lag("monthly_fee_int", 1).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("start_date"), "customer_id").orderBy("start_date", "id")).alias("prev_monthly_fee_int"),
    )

ranked = (
```

```sql
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(txn_type)) AS txn_type_list,
```

```sql
WITH prepared AS (
    -- Scope the ticket_events rows
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor
    FROM ticket_events
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event_at per ticket_id
    SELECT *, LAG(event_at) OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY event_at, id) AS prev_event_at
    FROM prepared
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR event_at > prev_event_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        ticket_id,
        session_no,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(event_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY ticket_id, session_no
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    ticket_id,
    session_no,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    n_events,
    duration_min
FROM per_session
ORDER BY session_start NULLS LAST, session_end NULLS LAST, ticket_id, session_no
LIMIT 5
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = (
    df_ticket_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
    )
)

with_prev = prepared.withColumn("prev_event_at", F.lag("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id").orderBy("event_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_event_at").isNull() | (F.col("event_at") > F.col("prev_event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("ticket_id", "session_no")
    .agg(
        F.min("event_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("event_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("event_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("event_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (

    .select(

        "session_no",
        "session_start",
        "session_end",
        "n_events",
        "duration_min",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("session_start").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("session_end").asc_nulls_last(),
```

```python
w_recent = Window.orderBy("running_min_discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

metrics = (
    df_promotions
    .withColumn("running_max_discount_pct", F.max("discount_pct").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_sum_discount_pct", F.sum("discount_pct").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_min_discount_pct", F.min("discount_pct").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("prev_discount_pct", F.lag("discount_pct", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct", "id")))
)

cleaned = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("starts_on") > "2023-11-19")
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "running_max_discount_pct",
        "running_sum_discount_pct",
        "running_min_discount_pct",
        F.datediff("starts_on", "ends_on").alias("days_ends_on_to_starts_on"),
        (F.col("running_max_discount_pct") - F.col("discount_pct")).alias("running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_channel"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy(F.col("running_sum_discount_pct").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

filtered = (
    ranked
    .filter((F.col("starts_on") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-04"))) & F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("channel_upper", F.upper("channel"))
)

metrics_promotions = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "starts_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "running_sum_discount_pct",
        "running_min_discount_pct",
        "days_ends_on_to_starts_on",
        "running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct",
        "latest_rank",
        "channel_upper",
        F.avg("running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("running_min_discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct"),
        F.count("running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("running_min_discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct"),
        F.max("running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("running_min_discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct"),
        F.last("running_max_discount_pct", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_running_max_discount_pct"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    metrics_promotions
    .select(
        "id",
        "running_min_discount_pct",
        "latest_rank",
        "channel_upper",
        "running_avg_running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct",
        "running_count_running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct",
        "last_known_running_max_discount_pct",
        F.cume_dist().over(w_part).alias("running_min_discount_pct_cume_dist"),
        F.last("running_count_running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct", ignorenulls=True).over(w_recent).alias("last_known_running_count_running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct"),
    )
)

filtered_promotions = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("running_min_discount_pct_cume_dist") < 0.62)
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("running_count_running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct") - F.col("latest_rank")).alias("running_count_running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct_minus_latest_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered_promotions
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("last_known_running_max_discount_pct") >= 0.33, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("last_known_running_max_discount_pct_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("running_count_running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct_minus_latest_rank") >= 73, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("running_count_running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct_minus_latest_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("running_avg_running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct"), 2).alias("avg_running_avg_running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("last_known_running_max_discount_pct", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("last_known_running_max_discount_pct_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_2"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("avg_running_avg_running_max_discount_pct_minus_discount_pct").desc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        location,
        budget,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_running AS budget_dense_rank,
        ROUND(budget / SUM(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY location, dept_name), 4) AS budget_share,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget DESC, id) AS budget_bucket,
        AVG(budget) OVER w_grp AS budget_avg_5
    FROM departments
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget NULLS LAST), w_grp AS (ORDER BY budget, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN budget_share >= 0.61 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS budget_share_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(budget, 0.95) AS budget_p95,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE location = 'Singapore') AS singapore_rows,
    ROUND(AVG(budget_avg_5), 2) AS avg_budget_avg_5,
    SUM(CASE WHEN location = 'New York' THEN budget_dense_rank ELSE 0 END) AS new_york_budget_dense_rank,
    MAX(budget_dense_rank) FILTER (WHERE location = 'Berlin') AS berlin_max_budget_dense_rank,
    SUM(CASE WHEN location = 'Bangkok' THEN budget_bucket ELSE 0 END) AS bangkok_budget_bucket
FROM metrics
GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget_share >= 0.61 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
HAVING budget_p95 > 0
ORDER BY bangkok_budget_bucket DESC;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("budget").asc_nulls_last())
w_grp = Window.orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)

metrics = (
    df_departments
    .select(
        "id",
        "location",
        "budget",
        F.dense_rank().over(w_running).alias("budget_dense_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("budget") / F.sum("budget").over(Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name"))), 4).alias("budget_share"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc(), "id")).alias("budget_bucket"),
        F.avg("budget").over(w_grp).alias("budget_avg_5"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("budget_share") >= 0.61, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("budget_share_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("budget", 0.95).alias("budget_p95"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("location") == "Singapore", 1)).alias("singapore_rows"),
        F.round(F.avg("budget_avg_5"), 2).alias("avg_budget_avg_5"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("location") == "New York", F.col("budget_dense_rank")).otherwise(0)).alias("new_york_budget_dense_rank"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("location") == "Berlin", F.col("budget_dense_rank"))).alias("berlin_max_budget_dense_rank"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("location") == "Bangkok", F.col("budget_bucket")).otherwise(0)).alias("bangkok_budget_bucket"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("budget_p95") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("bangkok_budget_bucket").desc())
)
```

```sql
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), last_restock) AS days_since_last_restock
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock > TO_DATE('2023-07-18')
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
    FROM base
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        row_num
    FROM latest
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY quantity DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
latest_inventory AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT id, product_id
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM deduped
    ) t
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    product_id,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM latest_inventory
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY event_count DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-07-18")))
    .withColumn("days_since_last_restock", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "last_restock"))
)

latest = (
    base
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

deduped = (
    latest
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc_nulls_first(), "id")))

latest_inventory = (

    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")))

result = (
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        site_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(read_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(read_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(kwh) AS session_kwh,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY site_id, burst_id
)
SELECT
    site_id,
    burst_id,
    session_end,
    session_kwh,
    COALESCE(session_kwh, 0.0) AS session_kwh_filled,
    ROUND(burst_id / NULLIF(session_kwh, 0), 3) AS burst_id_per_session_kwh
FROM sessions
```

```python
    )
)

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_read_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("read_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_read_at")) / 60 > 45), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions = (

    .groupBy("site_id", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("read_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("read_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.sum("kwh").alias("session_kwh"),
```

```python
with_last = (

    .alias("s")

    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
```

```python
        "s.id",
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.channel",
        "s.discount",
        F.col("c.status").alias("payment_status"),

    with_last
    .select(

        "customer_id",
        "channel",

        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("row_seq"),

        "customer_id",
```

```sql
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.moved_at_month, b.moved_at_month) AS moved_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.inbound_count, 0) AS inbound_count,
    a.inbound_total_qty,
    COALESCE(b.transfer_count, 0) AS transfer_count,
    b.transfer_total_qty,
    COALESCE(a.inbound_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.transfer_count, 0) AS inbound_count_minus_transfer_count

ORDER BY moved_at_month
```

```sql
        full_name,
        email,
        manager_id,
        is_remote,
        lead(salary) over w_part next_salary,
        lag(salary) over w_part prev_salary,
        row_number() over w_part row_seq
    from employees
    window w_part as (partition by manager_id order by hire_date, id)
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach employees attributes
    select
        src.id,
        src.email,
        src.manager_id,
        src.is_remote,
        src.row_seq,
        e.salary,
        e.level,
        e.full_name as employee_full_name
    from scored src
    left join employees e
        on src.manager_id = e.id
),
enriched_employees as (
    -- Attach employees attributes
    select src.*, p.salary as employee_salary
    from enriched src
    inner join employees p
        on src.manager_id = p.id
),
ranked as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select
        id,
        manager_id,
        row_seq,
        salary,
        level
    from (
        select *, rank() over (partition by manager_id, level order by employee_salary nulls last) as dedup_rank
        from enriched_employees
    ) ranked
    where dedup_rank = 1
),
metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        round(salary / sum(salary) over (partition by level), 4) salary_share,
        avg(salary) over (partition by manager_id order by salary, id rows between 5 preceding and current row) salary_avg_5
    from ranked
),
scored_employees as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        salary,
        salary_avg_5,
        lead(salary_share) over w_hist next_salary_share,
        lag(salary_share) over w_hist prev_salary_share,
        lag(row_seq) over w_hist prev_row_seq,
        row_number() over w_hist event_seq,
        cume_dist() over (partition by level order by salary desc) salary_cume_dist
    from metrics
    window w_hist as (partition by manager_id order by salary, id)

from (

        next_salary_share,
        salary,

unpivot (
```

```sql
WITH covered AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.played_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_1d,
        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_1d
    FROM plays a
    LEFT JOIN plays b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 1 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        listener_id,
        TO_DATE(played_at) AS played_at_day,
        prior_rows_1d,
        MIN(played_at) AS first_played_at,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        MAX(played_at) AS last_played_at,
        COUNT(DISTINCT listener_id) AS distinct_listener_ids
    FROM covered
    WHERE prior_ms_played_1d < 1700000
    GROUP BY listener_id, TO_DATE(played_at), prior_rows_1d
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    listener_id,
    prior_rows_1d,
    first_played_at,
    distinct_listener_ids
FROM rollup_base
```

```python
    df_plays.alias("a")

        & (F.col("b.played_at") < F.col("a.played_at"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") >= F.col("a.played_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.listener_id", "a.played_at")

        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),

)
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (

        burst_id,
        MIN(played_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(played_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(ms_played_bucket) AS session_ms_played_bucket,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY device, burst_id
)

FROM (
    SELECT n_events, session_start, device, burst_id
    FROM per_session

PIVOT (
    COUNT(burst_id)

)
```

```python
    df_plays
    .filter(F.col("source") == "radio")
    .select(

        "listener_id",
        "track_id",
        "played_at",
        "ms_played",
        "device",
        "is_skipped",
        (F.floor(F.col("ms_played") / 50000) * 50000).alias("ms_played_bucket"),
    )
)

flagged = (

    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_played_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("played_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_played_at")) / 60 > 45), 1).otherwise(0))
)

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("device", "burst_id")
    .agg(
```

```sql
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code DESC, id, k) AS dedup_rank
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
metrics_app_logs AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(status_code_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY status_code, id, k ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last4_min_status_code_bucket,

        AVG(status_code_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY dedup_rank, id, k ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS status_code_bucket_avg_3_prior
```

```sql
        session_end,
        session_requester_id,
        duration_min,

    FROM sessions
```

```sql
    FROM payments
```

```sql
    FROM deduped
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM gaps
)
SELECT
    id,
    status,
    island_id
FROM sessionized
ORDER BY status DESC NULLS LAST
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("location") == "Chiang Mai")
    .select(

        F.when(F.col("budget") >= 3429000, "High").when(F.col("budget") >= 881000, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("budget_tier"),

    .select(

        F.lead("budget_adjusted").over(w_running).alias("next_budget_adjusted"),
        F.lag("budget_adjusted").over(w_running).alias("prev_budget_adjusted"),
        F.row_number().over(w_running).alias("row_seq"),
        F.min("budget_adjusted").over(Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location")).alias("dept_name_min_budget_adjusted"),

        F.coalesce("location", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_location"),

verified = (

    .select("s.*")
```

```sql
),
```
```sql
with_gaps AS (
```

```sql
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_started_at IS NULL OR started_at > prev_started_at + INTERVAL 60 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM prev_events
),
sessions_sessions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        clean_country,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        started_at,
        clean_country,
        LEAD(session_id) OVER w_grp AS next_session_id,
        LAG(session_id) OVER w_grp AS prev_session_id,

    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates

        id,
        clean_country,
        seq_no,
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE

    new_session_flag,
    device,
    track_id,
    MIN(session_id) AS min_session_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT source) AS distinct_sources
```

```sql
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        grade_status,
        enrolled_at,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(term), ' ', '_')) AS term_slug
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE term IS NOT NULL

with_prev AS (

    SELECT *, LAG(enrolled_at) OVER (PARTITION BY term ORDER BY enrolled_at, id) AS prev_enrolled_at
    FROM recent

    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_enrolled_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(enrolled_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_enrolled_at)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY term ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM sessionized
    WHERE session_no > (SELECT AVG(session_no) FROM sessionized)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Join students
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.student_id,
        s.course_id,
        s.term,
        s.enrolled_at,
        s.term_slug,
        s.prev_enrolled_at,
        s.new_session_flag,
        s.session_no,
        st.student_name,
        st.cohort AS student_cohort,
        st.major AS student_major
    FROM with_activity s
    JOIN students st ON st.id = s.student_id AND st.enrolled_on IS NOT NULL
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    student_id,
    course_id,
    term,
    enrolled_at,
    term_slug,
    prev_enrolled_at,
    new_session_flag,
    session_no,
    student_major,
    CASE WHEN session_no >= 4 THEN 'A' WHEN session_no >= 2 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS session_no_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', prev_enrolled_at) AS prev_enrolled_at_week
```

```sql
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score_distance), 3) AS score_distance_percent_rank,
        score - LAG(score) OVER (ORDER BY score_distance, id) AS score_change,

)
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.desktop_count, 0) AS desktop_count,
    b.desktop_total_ms_played,
    COALESCE(a.speaker_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.desktop_count, 0) AS speaker_count_minus_desktop_count
```

```python
    df_plays
    .filter(F.col("device") == "speaker")

    .select(
```

```sql
    CASE WHEN prev_csat >= 4 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN prev_csat >= 3 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS prev_csat_tier,

FROM metrics
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped = (
    df_tickets
    .filter((F.col("channel") == "email") & (F.col("csat") > 3))
    .select(
        "id",
        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "closed_at",
        "csat",
        F.concat(F.col("channel"), F.lit("#"), F.col("csat").cast("string")).alias("channel_ref"),
    )
)

w_all_by_requester_id = Window.orderBy(F.col("requester_id").desc(), "id")
w_closed_at_month_agent_id = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "closed_at"), "agent_id")
w_closed_at_month_agent_id_by = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "closed_at"), "agent_id").orderBy(F.col("closed_at").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w_all_by_csat = Window.orderBy("csat", "id")
metrics = (
    scoped
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("csat") - F.lag("csat").over(w_all_by_requester_id)).alias("csat_change"),
        F.nth_value("requester_id", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("csat").orderBy(F.col("csat").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_requester_id"),
        F.nth_value("csat", 2).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("requester_id").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_csat"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("requester_id").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.round(F.avg("requester_id").over(Window.orderBy("csat", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)), 2).alias("requester_id_avg_2_prior"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_closed_at_month_agent_id).alias("rows_in_closed_at_month_agent_id"),
        F.lag("csat").over(Window.orderBy("csat", "id")).alias("prev_csat"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("closed_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("closed_at").over(w_closed_at_month_agent_id_by))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_closed_at"),
        F.round(F.col("csat") / F.nullif(F.sum("csat").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id", "csat")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("csat_share_of_agent_id_csat"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w_all_by_csat).alias("csat_quartile"),
        F.lead("closed_at").over(Window.orderBy("csat", "id")).alias("next_closed_at"),
        F.round(F.col("csat") - F.avg("csat").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "closed_at"), "agent_id")), 2).alias("csat_vs_closed_at_month_agent_id_avg"),
        F.round(F.col("csat") - F.avg("csat").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("closed_at"))), 2).alias("csat_vs_closed_at_to_date_avg"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "closed_at"), "agent_id").orderBy(F.col("closed_at").asc_nulls_last(), "id")).alias("closed_at_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "requester_id",
        "closed_at",
        "csat",
        "csat_change",
        "second_requester_id",
        "seq_no",
        "requester_id_avg_2_prior",
        "rows_in_closed_at_month_agent_id",
        "minutes_since_prev_closed_at",
        "csat_share_of_agent_id_csat",
        "csat_vs_closed_at_month_agent_id_avg",
        "csat_vs_closed_at_to_date_avg",
        "closed_at_rank",
        F.when(F.col("prev_csat") >= 4, "HIGH").when(F.col("prev_csat") >= 3, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("prev_csat_tier"),
        (F.col("requester_id_avg_2_prior") + F.col("csat_quartile")).alias("requester_id_avg_2_prior_plus_csat_quartile"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("second_requester_id").asc(), F.col("seq_no").desc())
)
```

```python
w_running = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("humidity", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)

        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        F.trim("firmware").alias("clean_firmware"),
        F.ceil("temp_c").alias("temp_c_whole"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        "temp_c_whole",
        F.min("temp_c_whole").over(w_running).alias("last3_min_temp_c_whole"),
        F.max("temp_c_whole").over(w_running).alias("last3_max_temp_c_whole"),
        F.count("temp_c_whole").over(w_running).alias("last3_count_temp_c_whole"),
        F.avg("temp_c_whole").over(w_running).alias("last3_avg_temp_c_whole"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))

    .select(

        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "status_bits",
        "last3_max_temp_c_whole",
        "last3_count_temp_c_whole",
        "seq_no",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

valid_device_readings = (
    sessionized
    .filter((F.col("reading_ts") >= F.lit("2025-09-01 07:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("device_code").isin(["DV-02", "DV-04", "DV-03"]))
```

```python
    df_tickets

        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "tags",
    )
)

w_agent_id = Window.partitionBy("agent_id")
w_channel_by_requester_id = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("requester_id").desc(), "id")

    prepared
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("requester_id").desc())).alias("requester_id_rank"),

        F.round(F.col("requester_id") / F.nullif(F.sum("requester_id").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("requester_id_share_of_agent_id"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("requester_id").desc(), "id")).alias("rn"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id", "priority").orderBy(F.col("requester_id").asc_nulls_last())), 3).alias("requester_id_cume_dist"),

        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id")).alias("rows_in_agent_id"),
        F.sum("requester_id").over(w_agent_id).alias("agent_id_sum_requester_id"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("channel").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id"))).alias("distinct_channel_in_agent_id"),
        F.lead("requester_id").over(w_channel_by_requester_id).alias("next_requester_id"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id", "priority").orderBy(F.col("requester_id").asc_nulls_last(), "id")).alias("requester_id_dense_rank"),
    )
)

    ranked
    .select(

        "agent_id",
        "priority",
        "channel",
```

```sql
    select id, val
    from price_tiers
    lateral view explode(tier_limits) x as val
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select *, dense_rank() over (order by val) as val_dense_rank
    from exploded
),
cleaned as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, val_dense_rank * val as val_dense_rank_times_val
    from enriched
    where val_dense_rank >= 4
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        val,
        val_dense_rank_times_val,
        dense_rank() over (order by val_dense_rank_times_val desc) as val_dense_rank_times_val_dense_rank,
        rank() over (order by val) as val_rank
    from cleaned
),
valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        greatest(val_dense_rank_times_val, val) as greatest_val_dense_rank_times_val_val,
        coalesce(val_dense_rank_times_val, 0) as val_dense_rank_times_val_filled
    from metrics
    where val_dense_rank_times_val_dense_rank = 8
),
base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, cast(val_rank as string) as val_rank_num
    from valid
    where greatest_val_dense_rank_times_val_val > 23
),
stats as (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    select
        case when val_dense_rank_times_val >= 84 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as val_dense_rank_times_val_tier,
        approx_percentile(val_dense_rank_times_val_filled, 0.5) as val_dense_rank_times_val_filled_p50,
        round(avg(val_dense_rank_times_val_filled), 2) as avg_val_dense_rank_times_val_filled,
        approx_percentile(val, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as val_quartiles
    from base
    group by case when val_dense_rank_times_val >= 84 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end
)
select val_dense_rank_times_val_tier
from stats
order by val_dense_rank_times_val_tier desc nulls last;
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("val_dense_rank") >= 4)
    .withColumn("val_dense_rank_times_val", (F.col("val_dense_rank") * F.col("val")))

    .select(

        "val_dense_rank_times_val",

    .withColumn("greatest_val_dense_rank_times_val_val", F.greatest("val_dense_rank_times_val", "val"))
    .withColumn("val_dense_rank_times_val_filled", F.coalesce("val_dense_rank_times_val", F.lit(0)))

base = (

    .filter(F.col("greatest_val_dense_rank_times_val_val") > 23)
    .withColumn("val_rank_num", F.col("val_rank").cast("string"))
)

stats = (

    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("val_dense_rank_times_val") >= 84, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("val_dense_rank_times_val_tier"),
```

```sql
    FROM base
```

```sql
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id) + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM enriched
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        started_at,
        country,
        seq_no,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
```

```sql
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2026-01-01', read_at) AS days_since_read_at,
        TO_DATE(read_at) AS read_at_date
    FROM windowed
    WHERE quality_group NOT IN ('group_b', 'other')
),
qualified AS (

    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1

            WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id
        )
),
enriched AS (

    SELECT
        s.*,
        si.installed_kw AS site_installed_kw,
        si.tariff AS site_tariff,
```

```python
    df_stock_moves
    .filter(F.col("warehouse_id").isNotNull())

        "sku_id",
        "move_type",
        "qty",
        "moved_at",
        "operator",
        "unit_price",
        F.date_format(F.col("moved_at"), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:00").alias("moved_at_label"),
    )
)

with_parent_sku = (
    valid.alias("s")
    .join(df_skus.alias("sk"), F.col("sk.id") == F.col("s.sku_id"), "left")
    .join(df_warehouses.alias("w"), F.col("w.id") == F.col("s.warehouse_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.warehouse_id",
        "s.sku_id",
        "s.move_type",
        "s.qty",
        "s.moved_at",
        "s.operator",
        "s.unit_price",
        "s.moved_at_label",
        F.col("sk.unit_cost").alias("sku_unit_cost"),
        F.col("w.city").alias("warehouse_city"),
        F.col("w.opened_on").alias("warehouse_opened_on"),

)

without_matches = (
    with_parent_sku.alias("s")
    .join(df_stock_moves.alias("st"), (F.col("st.sku_id") == F.col("s.sku_id")) & (F.col("st.operator") != "op_dew") & (F.to_date(F.col("st.moved_at")) < F.lit("2025-02-18").cast("date")), "left_semi")
)

)

stats = (
    filtered
    .groupBy(
        F.year("moved_at").alias("moved_at_year"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("ends_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(F.col("starts_on").between("2023-12-05", "2025-01-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        F.lower("promo_code").alias("promo_code_lower"),
        F.add_months("ends_on", 6).alias("ends_on_plus_months"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter((F.col("ends_on") >= F.lit("2023-09-10").cast("date")) & (F.col("ends_on_plus_months") <= "2023-08-23"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "promo_code_lower",
        "ends_on_plus_months",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "ends_on").alias("days_since_ends_on"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("N/A")).alias("channel_filled"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("starts_on") >= "2024-03-01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "promo_code",
        "ends_on",
        F.count("days_since_ends_on").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("ends_on_plus_months", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("last3_count_days_since_ends_on"),

    )
)

    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("last3_max_days_since_ends_on").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code")).alias("promo_code_count_last3_max_days_since_ends_on"),
        F.first("last3_sum_days_since_ends_on", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("last3_sum_days_since_ends_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_last3_sum_days_since_ends_on"),

    )
)

    .select(

        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("promo_code")).alias("promo_code_list"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost_rank", "id")

filtered = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") > F.lit("2023-04-24").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_format("delivered_date", "MMM yyyy").alias("delivered_date_label"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") < "2023-07-01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "delivered_date_label",
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("shipped_date"), "carrier").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc(), "id")).alias("cost_bucket"),
        F.first("cost", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_cost"),
        F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id"))), 4).alias("cost_share"),
        F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("status", "carrier"))), 4).alias("cost_share_2"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc_nulls_last())).alias("cost_rank"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("shipped_date").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.sum("cost_share_2").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "shipped_date"), "carrier").orderBy("cost_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_cost_share_2"),
    )
)

metrics_shipments = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("prev_cost_rank", F.lag("cost_rank").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("prev_running_cost_share_2", F.lag("running_cost_share_2").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("next_running_cost_share_2", F.lead("running_cost_share_2").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("cumulative_cost_bucket", F.sum("cost_bucket").over(Window.orderBy("shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

with_windows = (
    metrics_shipments
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date_label",
        "cost_bucket",
        "cost_share_2",
        "cost_rank",
        "event_seq",
        "next_running_cost_share_2",
        "cumulative_cost_bucket",
        F.min("cost_share").over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_cost_share"),
        F.max("cost_share").over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_cost_share"),

        F.sum("cost_share").over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_cost_share"),
    )
)

    with_windows
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "shipped_date").alias("activity_month"), "carrier")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("carrier").alias("distinct_carriers"),
        F.round(F.avg("running_avg_cost_share"), 2).alias("avg_running_avg_cost_share"),
        F.round(F.avg("running_max_cost_share"), 2).alias("avg_running_max_cost_share"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "DHL", 1)).alias("dhl_rows"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "FedEx", F.col("next_running_cost_share_2"))).alias("fedex_total_next_running_cost_share_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "activity_month",
        "carrier",
        "distinct_carriers",
        "avg_running_avg_cost_share",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("carrier").asc_nulls_first())
```

```sql
WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        INITCAP(TRIM(supplier_name)) AS supplier_name_title,
        COALESCE(city, 'NONE') AS resolved_city
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE country = 'SG'
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS FIRST) AS dedup_rank
        FROM valid
    ) x
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        rating,
        supplier_name_title,
        resolved_city,
        dedup_rank,
        LAG(rating) OVER w_grp AS prev_rating,
        LEAD(rating) OVER w_grp AS next_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS event_seq
    FROM latest
    WHERE rating >= 2.3
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY dedup_rank, id)
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.product_name IS NOT NULL
        )
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN next_rating >= 4.0 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS next_rating_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(next_rating, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS next_rating_quartiles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    MAX(prev_rating) AS max_prev_rating,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids_2,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids_3,
    AVG(next_rating) AS avg_next_rating
FROM eligible
GROUP BY CASE WHEN next_rating >= 4.0 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
ORDER BY distinct_ids_3 NULLS FIRST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("dedup_rank", "id")

valid = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("country") == "SG")
    .select(
        "id",
        "country",
        "city",
        "rating",
        F.initcap(F.trim("supplier_name")).alias("supplier_name_title"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_city"),
    )
)

latest = (
    valid
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc_nulls_first())))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)

metrics = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("rating") >= 2.3)
    .select(
        "id",
        "rating",
        "supplier_name_title",
        "resolved_city",
        "dedup_rank",
        F.lag("rating").over(w_grp).alias("prev_rating"),
        F.lead("rating").over(w_grp).alias("next_rating"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.product_name").isNotNull()), "left_anti")

result = (

    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("next_rating") >= 4.0, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("next_rating_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("next_rating", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("next_rating_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.max("prev_rating").alias("max_prev_rating"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_2"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_3"),
        F.avg("next_rating").alias("avg_next_rating"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_ids_3").asc_nulls_first())
```

```python
        "opened_at",
        "closed_at",
        "channel",
        "csat",
        "tags",
    )
)

    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_opened_at").isNull() | (F.col("opened_at") > F.col("prev_opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)
```

```sql
unioned AS (
```

```python
    df_policyholders
    .filter((F.col("region").isin("South", "East", "North")) & (F.col("risk_score") > 0.2))

        "id",
        "risk_score",
        "joined_on",
        "segment",
        F.round(F.col("risk_score") * 1.5, 2).alias("risk_score_adj"),
    )
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([33, 34, 40]) & (F.col("shipped_date") > F.lit("2023-02-20").cast("date")))
    .select(

        "delivered_date",
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "shipped_date").alias("shipped_date_period"),
        F.substring("carrier", 1, 4).alias("carrier_prefix"),

with_windows = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("shipped_date_period", "id")))
)

prev_events = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("prev_shipped_date_period", F.lag("shipped_date_period").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("shipped_date_period", "id")))
)

flagged = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_shipped_date_period").isNull() | (F.col("shipped_date_period") > F.col("prev_shipped_date_period") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("shipped_date_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

prev_events_2 = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("prev_shipped_date_period_2", F.lag("shipped_date_period").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("shipped_date_period", "id")))
)

with_gaps = (
    prev_events_2
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_shipped_date_period_2").isNull() | (F.col("shipped_date_period") > F.col("prev_shipped_date_period_2") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized_shipments = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("shipped_date_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

kept_keys = (
    sessionized_shipments
    .select("order_id", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("shipped_date") <= "2024-01-01")
        .select("order_id", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    sessionized_shipments
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

    verified
    .withColumn("order_id_max_seq_no", F.max("seq_no").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id")))
    .withColumn("seq_no_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("seq_no")))

)

    scored
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")

)

    with_dims
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "prev_shipped_date_period").alias("quarter_start"),
        F.when(F.col("session_start_flag") >= 1, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("session_start_flag_tier"),

        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("txn_time") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-17")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "is_flagged",
        F.lower("txn_type").alias("txn_type_lower"),
        F.hour("txn_time").alias("txn_time_hour"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    base
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

metrics = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "is_flagged",
        "txn_type_lower",
        "txn_time_hour",
        "session_start_flag",
        F.sum("txn_time_hour").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "txn_time"), "account_id").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)).alias("txn_time_hour_sum_90d"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("account_id", "txn_type").orderBy(F.col("session_start_flag").asc_nulls_first())).alias("session_start_flag_rank"),
        F.sum("txn_time_hour").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("txn_time"), "txn_type").orderBy("session_id", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_txn_time_hour"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("account_id", "txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "txn_type_lower",
        "txn_time_hour_sum_90d",
        "seq_no",
        F.stddev_samp("seq_no").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "txn_time"))).alias("txn_time_period_stddev_samp_seq_no"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.orderBy("amount", "id")).alias("amount_bucket"),
        F.sum("session_start_flag_rank").over(Window.orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_session_start_flag_rank"),
        F.sum("txn_time_hour_sum_90d").over(Window.orderBy("session_start_flag_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_txn_time_hour_sum_90d"),
    )
)

scored_transactions = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("txn_time_period_stddev_samp_seq_no") < 5)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("seq_no").over(Window.orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_seq_no"),
        F.max("seq_no").over(Window.orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_seq_no"),
        F.min("seq_no").over(Window.orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_seq_no"),
        F.sum("seq_no").over(Window.orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_seq_no"),
        F.first("running_txn_time_hour_sum_90d", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("amount_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_running_txn_time_hour_sum_90d"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_transactions
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("year", "txn_time").alias("year_start"),
        F.when(F.col("running_min_seq_no") >= 7.3, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("running_min_seq_no_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("quarter", "txn_time").alias("quarter_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("running_sum_seq_no").alias("min_running_sum_seq_no"),
        F.percentile_approx("txn_time_hour_sum_90d", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("txn_time_hour_sum_90d_quartiles"),
    )
    .withColumn("min_running_sum_seq_no_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("year_start").orderBy(F.col("min_running_sum_seq_no").desc())))
)
```

```sql
    -- Price each reading with the tariff window it falls into
    SELECT
        r.id,
        r.site_id,
        r.read_at,
        r.kwh,
        r.quality,
        st.zone,
        tw.rate,
        ROUND(r.kwh * tw.rate, 2) AS energy_cost
    FROM meter_readings r
    JOIN sites st ON st.id = r.site_id
    JOIN tariff_windows tw
      ON tw.tariff = st.tariff
     AND r.read_at >= tw.valid_from
     AND r.read_at < tw.valid_to
),
reading_stats AS (
    -- Per-site meter_readings metrics
    SELECT site_id, COUNT(*) AS reading_count, MIN(read_at) AS first_reading_read_at
    FROM meter_readings
    GROUP BY site_id
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach meter_readings metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(m.reading_count, 0) AS reading_count,
        m.first_reading_read_at
    FROM matched s
    LEFT JOIN reading_stats m ON m.site_id = s.site_id
)
SELECT
    id,
    site_id,
    zone,
    rate,
    reading_count,
    first_reading_read_at
FROM with_stats
ORDER BY reading_count DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

matched = (
    df_meter_readings.alias("r")
    .join(df_sites.alias("st"), F.col("st.id") == F.col("r.site_id"), "inner")
    .join(
        df_tariff_windows.alias("tw"),
        (F.col("tw.tariff") == F.col("st.tariff"))
        & (F.col("r.read_at") >= F.col("tw.valid_from"))
        & (F.col("r.read_at") < F.col("tw.valid_to")),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "r.id",
        "r.site_id",
        "r.read_at",
        "r.kwh",
        "r.quality",
        "st.zone",
        "tw.rate",
        F.round(F.col("r.kwh") * F.col("tw.rate"), 2).alias("energy_cost"),
    )
)

reading_stats = (
    df_meter_readings
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("reading_count"),
        F.min("read_at").alias("first_reading_read_at"),
    )

with_stats = (

    )

result = (

        "site_id",
        "zone",
        "rate",
        "reading_count",

    )
)
```

```python
    .select(
```

```python
    )

top_rows = metrics.filter(F.col("end_date_seq") <= 5)

w_holder_id = Window.partitionBy("holder_id")
with_windows = (
    top_rows
    .select(
```

```sql
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        closed_at,
        priority,
        channel,
        csat,
        tags
    FROM tickets

with_prev AS (
    -- Previous closed_at per agent_id
    SELECT *, LAG(closed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id ORDER BY closed_at, id) AS prev_closed_at
    FROM cleaned
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_closed_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(closed_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_closed_at)) / 60 > 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id ORDER BY closed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        agent_id,
        session_no,
        MIN(closed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(closed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(csat) AS session_csat,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(closed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(closed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY agent_id, session_no
),
annotated AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        agent_id,
        session_no,
        session_start,
        session_end,
        session_csat,
        duration_min,
        session_end + INTERVAL 15 MINUTES AS session_end_plus_15m
    FROM sessions
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach tickets metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.priority NOT IN ('P4', 'P1')) FROM tickets t WHERE t.agent_id = s.agent_id) AS ticket_priority_count,
        (SELECT MAX(t.closed_at) FROM tickets t WHERE t.agent_id = s.agent_id) AS last_ticket_closed_at
    FROM annotated s
)
SELECT
    agent_id,
    session_no,
    session_start,
    session_csat,
    duration_min,
    session_end_plus_15m,
    ticket_priority_count,
    last_ticket_closed_at,
    DAYOFWEEK(session_start) AS session_start_dayofweek,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', last_ticket_closed_at) AS last_ticket_closed_at_year
FROM profiled
ORDER BY last_ticket_closed_at
```

```python
        "channel",
        "csat",
        "tags",
    )
)

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_closed_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("closed_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_closed_at")) / 60 > 45), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id").orderBy("closed_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("agent_id", "session_no")
    .agg(
        F.min("closed_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("closed_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.sum("csat").alias("session_csat"),

        "t.last_ticket_closed_at",
    )
)

result = (
```
