```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        artist_id,
        title,
        duration_sec,
        release_date,
        is_explicit,
        bpm
    FROM tracks
),
stats AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        artist_id,
        DATE_FORMAT(release_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS release_date_ym,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_explicit = FALSE) AS n_is_explicit_false,
        MIN(release_date) AS first_release_date,
        ROUND(SUM(bpm) / NULLIF(SUM(duration_sec), 0), 3) AS bpm_to_duration_sec_ratio,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_explicit = TRUE) AS n_is_explicit_true
    FROM scoped_tracks
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows with no matching tracks
    SELECT s.*
    FROM stats s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM tracks t
            WHERE t.artist_id = s.artist_id
              AND UPPER(TRIM(t.title)) LIKE 'M%'
              AND SIZE(t.moods) >= 2
        )
),
enriched_artist AS (
    -- Attach artist attributes
    SELECT
        s.artist_id,
        s.release_date_ym,
        s.first_release_date,
        s.n_is_explicit_true,
        a.debut_year AS artist_debut_year,
        a.is_verified AS artist_is_verified
    FROM with_activity s
    LEFT JOIN artists a ON a.id = s.artist_id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY artist_id, n_is_explicit_true ORDER BY first_release_date, artist_id, release_date_ym) AS first_release_date_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY artist_is_verified, n_is_explicit_true ORDER BY first_release_date, artist_id, release_date_ym) AS first_release_date_dense_rank_2,
        MAX(n_is_explicit_true) OVER (PARTITION BY artist_is_verified) AS artist_is_verified_max_n_is_explicit_true
    FROM enriched_artist
),
track_stats AS (
    -- Per-artist tracks metrics
    SELECT artist_id, COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM tracks
    GROUP BY artist_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach tracks metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(t.track_count, 0) AS track_count
    FROM ranked s
    LEFT JOIN track_stats t ON t.artist_id = s.artist_id
),
with_parent AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT s.*, a.genre AS artist_genre
    FROM profiled s
    LEFT JOIN artists a ON a.id = s.artist_id
)
SELECT
    artist_id,
    release_date_ym,
    n_is_explicit_true,
    artist_debut_year,
    artist_is_verified,
    first_release_date_dense_rank,
    first_release_date_dense_rank_2,
    artist_is_verified_max_n_is_explicit_true,

FROM with_parent
ORDER BY first_release_date_dense_rank, release_date_ym DESC
```

```python
        "duration_sec",
        "release_date",
        "is_explicit",
        "bpm",
    )
)

stats = (
    scoped_tracks
    .groupBy(
        "artist_id",
        F.date_format("release_date", "yyyy-MM").alias("release_date_ym"),
```

```python
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("running_max_monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("plan") != "basic")
    .select(

        "plan",
        "end_date",

)

with_windows = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "status",
        "clean_plan",
        F.count("monthly_fee").over(w_recent).alias("running_count_monthly_fee"),
        F.min("monthly_fee").over(w_recent).alias("running_min_monthly_fee"),
        F.max("monthly_fee").over(w_recent).alias("running_max_monthly_fee"),
        F.avg("monthly_fee").over(w_recent).alias("running_avg_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "status",
        "clean_plan",
        "running_min_monthly_fee",
        "running_max_monthly_fee",
        "running_avg_monthly_fee",
        F.avg("running_avg_monthly_fee").over(w_hist).alias("running_avg_monthly_fee_avg_6_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("running_avg_monthly_fee").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.sum("running_avg_monthly_fee").over(Window.partitionBy("plan", "status").orderBy("running_min_monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_running_avg_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

    metrics
    .filter(F.col("seq_no") != 8)
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "status",
        "clean_plan",
        "running_min_monthly_fee",
        "running_avg_monthly_fee_avg_6_prior",
        "seq_no",
        "running_running_avg_monthly_fee",
        (F.col("seq_no") + F.col("running_min_monthly_fee")).alias("seq_no_plus_running_min_monthly_fee"),
        F.round((F.col("running_avg_monthly_fee") * 100), 2).alias("running_avg_monthly_fee_scaled"),

    .filter(F.col("seq_no_plus_running_min_monthly_fee") >= 37)

)

    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("seq_no_plus_running_min_monthly_fee").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

    ranked_subscriptions
    .groupBy("plan")
    .agg(

        F.percentile_approx("seq_no", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("seq_no_quartiles"),
    )
)
```

```python
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("event_type", "session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
duration_sec_by_session_id = df_web_events.groupBy("session_id").agg(F.avg("duration_sec").alias("avg_web_event_duration_sec"))

deduped = (
    df_web_events
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

ranked = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("event_type", "page").orderBy("duration_sec", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        "rn",
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("event_time") - F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
```

```sql
    FROM flagged

per_session AS (

    SELECT

        session_id,
        MIN(moved_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(moved_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(moved_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(moved_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY sku_id, session_id
)

    session_end,
    events,
    duration_min
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.replied_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.resolved_count, 0) AS replied_count_minus_resolved_count
```

```sql
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(stock_qty, 0) AS stock_qty_filled,
        stock_qty - price AS stock_qty_minus_price,
        COALESCE(brand, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_brand
    FROM products
    WHERE brand IS NOT NULL
      AND launch_date >= DATE '2023-06-10'
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching inventory per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.product_name,
        s.price,
        s.cost,
        s.launch_date,
        s.stock_qty_filled,
        x.inventory_last_restock
    FROM filtered s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.last_restock AS inventory_last_restock
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.quantity DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items x
            WHERE x.product_id = s.id
              AND x.order_id IN (5, 30)
        )
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        price,
        launch_date,
        AVG(price) OVER (ORDER BY price, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS price_avg_5,
        LAST_VALUE(cost) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY stock_qty_filled, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_cost,
        LAST_VALUE(price) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY launch_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_price
    FROM not_flagged
),
enriched_products AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        launch_date,
        price_avg_5,
        last_known_cost,
        last_known_price,
        COUNT(price_avg_5) OVER w_hist AS running_count_price_avg_5,
        MIN(price_avg_5) OVER w_hist AS running_min_price_avg_5,
        AVG(price_avg_5) OVER w_hist AS running_avg_price_avg_5
    FROM enriched
    WHERE launch_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2024-01-01'
    WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY last_known_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        last_known_price,
        running_avg_price_avg_5,
        last_known_cost
    FROM enriched_products
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR metric IN (last_known_price, running_avg_price_avg_5, last_known_cost)
);
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.orderBy("last_known_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

    df_products
    .filter(F.col("brand").isNotNull() & (F.col("launch_date") >= F.lit("2023-06-10").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("stock_qty", F.lit(0)).alias("stock_qty_filled"),
        (F.col("stock_qty") - F.col("price")).alias("stock_qty_minus_price"),
        F.coalesce("brand", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_brand"),
    )
)

latest_match = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_inventory.alias("c"), (F.col("c.product_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.quantity").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(

        "s.cost",

)

enriched = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "price",
        "launch_date",
        F.avg("price").over(Window.orderBy("price", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)).alias("price_avg_5"),
        F.last("cost", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("stock_qty_filled", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_cost"),
        F.last("price", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("launch_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_price"),
    )
)

enriched_products = (

    .filter(F.col("launch_date").between("2023-10-01", "2024-01-01"))

        "launch_date",
        "price_avg_5",
        "last_known_cost",
```

```sql
        FROM with_trends
```

```sql
    SELECT
```
```sql
        s.id,
```

```sql
),
```

```sql
    SELECT enrollment_grade_status, AVG(enrollment_score) AS avg_enrollment_score
    FROM with_children
    GROUP BY enrollment_grade_status
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_enrollment_score,
        ROUND(s.enrollment_score - g.avg_enrollment_score, 2) AS enrollment_score_minus_avg
    FROM with_children s
    JOIN enrollment_grade_status_stats g ON g.enrollment_grade_status = s.enrollment_grade_status
    WHERE s.enrollment_score > g.avg_enrollment_score
),
with_counts AS (

        s.*,

    enrollment_score_minus_avg,

FROM with_counts
WHERE enrollment_score_minus_avg BETWEEN -70.0 AND 30.0
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_courses = (
    df_courses
    .filter((F.col("level").isin("core", "advanced")) & (F.length(F.trim(F.col("course_code"))) >= 5))
    .select(

        "dept",

        "level",
        F.coalesce(F.col("credits"), F.lit(0)).alias("credits_filled"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("level"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("level_or_unknown"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    scoped_courses
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("credits").desc(), F.col("id").desc())))

)

        F.col("e.id").alias("enrollment_id"),
        F.col("e.grade_status").alias("enrollment_grade_status"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.orderBy("seq_no_3", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("manager_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "hire_date").alias("days_since_hire_date"),
        F.coalesce("level", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("level_filled"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "email",
        "hire_date",
        F.min("salary").over(Window.partitionBy("dept_id", "job_title").orderBy("days_since_hire_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_salary"),
        F.count("salary").over(Window.partitionBy("dept_id", "job_title").orderBy("days_since_hire_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_salary"),
        F.sum("salary").over(Window.partitionBy("dept_id", "job_title").orderBy("days_since_hire_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_salary"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("hire_date")).orderBy("salary")).alias("salary_cume_dist"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "hire_date",
        "running_sum_salary",
        F.lead("running_count_salary").over(Window.orderBy("running_min_salary", "id")).alias("next_running_count_salary"),
        F.lag("running_count_salary").over(Window.orderBy("running_min_salary", "id")).alias("prev_running_count_salary"),
        F.lead("running_sum_salary").over(Window.orderBy("running_min_salary", "id")).alias("next_running_sum_salary"),
        F.lag("running_sum_salary").over(Window.orderBy("running_min_salary", "id")).alias("prev_running_sum_salary"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("running_min_salary", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("running_sum_salary").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no_2"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    enriched
    .filter((F.col("hire_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-08-09"))) & F.col("prev_running_sum_salary").between(415000, 688000))
    .select(
        "id",
        "next_running_count_salary",
        "prev_running_sum_salary",
        "seq_no",
        "seq_no_2",
        (F.col("prev_running_sum_salary") * F.col("seq_no_2")).alias("prev_running_sum_salary_times_seq_no_2"),
    )
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "next_running_count_salary",
        "prev_running_sum_salary",
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("seq_no", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("seq_no_2").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no_3"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.orderBy("next_running_count_salary", "id")).alias("next_running_count_salary_bucket"),
        F.sum("seq_no").over(Window.orderBy("next_running_count_salary", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_seq_no"),
    )
)

scored_employees = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("seq_no_3").between(4, 7))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("row_seq").over(w_recent).alias("running_row_seq"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("prev_running_sum_salary").desc_nulls_last())).alias("prev_running_sum_salary_dense_rank"),
    )
)

with_windows_employees = (
    scored_employees
    .select(
        "id",
        "next_running_count_salary",
        "seq_no_3",
        "next_running_count_salary_bucket",
        "prev_running_sum_salary_dense_rank",
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("seq_no_3").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no_3_bucket"),
        F.sum("prev_running_sum_salary").over(Window.orderBy("prev_running_sum_salary_dense_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_prev_running_sum_salary"),
        F.lag("running_seq_no", 2).over(Window.orderBy("next_running_count_salary_bucket", "id")).alias("prev_running_seq_no"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.orderBy("prev_running_sum_salary", "id")).alias("prev_running_sum_salary_bucket"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows_employees
    .groupBy("prev_running_seq_no")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("prev_running_sum_salary_bucket", 0.5).alias("prev_running_sum_salary_bucket_p50"),
        F.percentile_approx("next_running_count_salary_bucket", 0.95).alias("next_running_count_salary_bucket_p95"),
        F.round(F.avg("prev_running_sum_salary_bucket"), 2).alias("avg_prev_running_sum_salary_bucket"),
    )
    .orderBy("prev_running_seq_no")
)
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.outbound_count, 0) AS outbound_count,
    COALESCE(b.outbound_avg_qty, 0) AS outbound_avg_qty,
    COALESCE(a.transfer_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.outbound_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM transfer_by_sku a
FULL OUTER JOIN outbound_by_sku b
  ON a.sku_id = b.sku_id
ORDER BY sku_id
```

```sql
        FIRST_VALUE(read_at) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY kwh_bucket DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_read_at,
        SUM(kwh_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id) AS site_id_sum_kwh_bucket,

        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, quality ORDER BY kwh ASC NULLS LAST, id) AS kwh_rank,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY kwh), 3) AS kwh_percent_rank,
        MAX(kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY read_at ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS kwh_max_1_prior,

    FROM valid_readings
```

```python
    )

w_site_id = Window.partitionBy("site_id")
ranked = (
    valid_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",

        F.lead("kwh_bucket", 1, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("read_at", "id")).alias("next_kwh_bucket"),
        F.first("kwh", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("kwh_bucket").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_kwh"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("quality").over(w_site_id)).alias("distinct_quality_in_site_id"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("kwh_bucket").desc())).alias("kwh_bucket_dense_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("kwh_bucket").desc(), "id")).alias("kwh_bucket_dense_rank_2"),

        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("read_at")).alias("read_at_rank"),
```

```python
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        F.col("quantity").cast("string").alias("quantity_num"),

        "last_restock",

        "seq_no",

        F.last("running_avg_seq_no", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_running_avg_seq_no"),

        "last_restock",
        "quantity_num",
        "seq_no",

        "running_count_seq_no_avg_5_prior",

    )
)

filtered_inventory = (

    .select(

        "last_restock",
        "quantity_num",
        "seq_no",
        "running_count_seq_no",
        "running_count_seq_no_avg_5_prior",
        "running_count_seq_no_avg_5_prior_num",
        F.date_format("last_restock", "yyyy-MM").alias("last_restock_label"),
```

```python
    df_tickets
    .select(

        "closed_at",

        "csat",

        F.length(F.trim(F.col("priority"))).alias("priority_len"),

    )
)

windowed = (

    .select(
        "*",

        F.round(F.col("csat") / F.nullif(F.sum("csat").over(Window.partitionBy("channel")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("csat_share_of_channel"),

)

        "channel",

        "channel_sum_csat",
```

```python
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_event_time").isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.col("prev_event_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_web_events = gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

    .withColumn("prev_running_avg_duration_sec", F.lag("running_avg_duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("running_avg_duration_sec", "id")))
```

```sql
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        quality
    FROM meter_readings
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous read_at per site_id
    SELECT *, LAG(read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY read_at, id) AS prev_read_at
    FROM cleaned
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_read_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(read_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_read_at)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        site_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(read_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(read_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(kwh) AS session_kwh,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY site_id, burst_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    site_id,
    burst_id,
    session_end,
    event_count,
    session_kwh
FROM per_session
ORDER BY event_count DESC NULLS FIRST, burst_id
```

```python
    .select(

        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
    )
)

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_read_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("read_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_read_at")) / 60 > 60), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("site_id", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("read_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("read_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.sum("kwh").alias("session_kwh"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("read_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("read_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),

)

        "session_end",
```

```sql
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating DESC, id ASC) AS rating_bucket

)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
```

```python
        "country",
```

```sql
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.played_at,

        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_12h
    FROM plays a
    LEFT JOIN plays b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows with no matching plays
    SELECT s.*
    FROM matched s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM plays p
            WHERE p.listener_id = s.listener_id
              AND p.ms_played <= 302279
              AND p.source <> 'radio'

),
derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns

        id,
        played_at,

        YEAR(played_at) AS played_at_year,
        DATE_FORMAT(played_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS played_at_label
    FROM with_activity
),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = (
    df_ticket_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("event_at")).alias("days_since_event_at"),
    )
)

with_prev = prepared.withColumn("prev_event_at", F.lag("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_event_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("event_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_event_at")) / 60 > 120), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("event_type", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("event_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("event_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.sum("days_since_event_at").alias("session_days_since_event_at"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("event_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("event_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),

)

    .groupBy("n_events")
    .agg(

        F.min("session_end").alias("first_session_end"),
    )
)

result = (
    per_group
    .select(

        "n_event_type_resolved",
        "n_rows",

        "pct_event_type_in_escalated_reso",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("dept_name").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("budget_level", F.when(F.col("budget") >= 3211000, "High").when(F.col("budget") >= 1624000, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("dept_name_clean", F.coalesce("dept_name", F.lit("DIRECT")))
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("dept_name").isin(["Sales", "HR"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("budget").over(w_running).alias("budget_avg_2_prior"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_running_2).alias("budget_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("budget").over(Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_budget"),
    )
)

latest = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy(F.col("budget_dense_rank").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

cleaned_departments = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("dept_name").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("budget_avg_2_prior") * 0.85), 2).alias("adjusted_budget_avg_2_prior"),
        F.coalesce("location", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("location_clean"),
    )

with_windows_departments = (
    cleaned_departments
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy(F.col("adjusted_budget_avg_2_prior").asc_nulls_first())).alias("adjusted_budget_avg_2_prior_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("adjusted_budget_avg_2_prior").over(Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name").orderBy("row_num", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_adjusted_budget_avg_2_prior"),
        F.round((F.col("budget_dense_rank") / F.sum("budget_dense_rank").over(Window.partitionBy("location"))), 4).alias("budget_dense_rank_share"),
```

```sql
kept_keys AS (
```

```sql
reconciled AS (
```

```sql
    FROM valid s

),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates

        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget DESC) AS budget_percent_rank,

        COUNT(budget) OVER w_part AS dept_name_count_budget,
        STDDEV_SAMP(budget) OVER w_part_2 AS location_stddev_samp_budget

),
eligible AS (

-- Grouped metrics

    location,
    CASE WHEN budget_percent_rank >= 0.77 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS budget_percent_rank_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(location_stddev_samp_budget, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS location_stddev_samp_budget_quartiles,
    SUM(CASE WHEN dept_name = 'Marketing' THEN location_max_budget ELSE 0 END) AS marketing_location_max_budget,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(dept_name_count_budget, 0.9) AS dept_name_count_budget_p90,
    ROUND(AVG(location_stddev_samp_budget), 2) AS avg_location_stddev_samp_budget,
    AVG(location_stddev_samp_budget) AS avg_location_stddev_samp_budget_2,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("dept_name")

    df_departments

    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("location", F.lit("unassigned")).alias("location_filled"),
        F.coalesce("location", F.lit("unassigned")).alias("location_filled_2"),
        F.coalesce("location", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_location"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    valid
    .select("location")
    .intersectAll(

        .filter(~F.col("dept_name").isin(["Finance", "HR"]))
        .select("location")
    )
)

reconciled = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.location") == F.col("k.location")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")

)

result = (
    eligible
    .groupBy(
        "location",
        F.when(F.col("budget_percent_rank") >= 0.77, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("budget_percent_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("location_stddev_samp_budget", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("location_stddev_samp_budget_quartiles"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "Marketing", F.col("location_max_budget")).otherwise(0)).alias("marketing_location_max_budget"),
        F.percentile_approx("dept_name_count_budget", 0.9).alias("dept_name_count_budget_p90"),
        F.round(F.avg("location_stddev_samp_budget"), 2).alias("avg_location_stddev_samp_budget"),
```

```sql
    WHERE s.score >= g.median_score
```

```sql
    AVG(running_max_balance) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CLOSED') AS closed_avg_running_max_balance,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS num_status,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 END) AS closed_count
FROM latest
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN running_min_balance >= 70000 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', opened_date))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("session_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("account_id").isin([21, 23, 24, 25]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.trim("merchant").alias("clean_merchant"),
        F.concat_ws(",", "merchant", "txn_type").alias("merchant_txn_type_key"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_merchant"),
    )
)

joined = (
    valid
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("a"), F.col("e.account_id") == F.col("a.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("a.balance"), F.col("a.account_type"))
)

flagged = (
    joined
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

with_windows = (
    islands
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "merchant",
        "clean_merchant",
        "merchant_txn_type_key",
        "balance",
        "account_type",
        F.max("balance").over(w_recent).alias("running_max_balance"),
        F.min("balance").over(w_recent).alias("running_min_balance"),
        F.avg("balance").over(w_recent).alias("running_avg_balance"),
        F.lag("amount", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "account_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")).alias("prev_amount"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("a"), F.col("src.account_id") == F.col("a.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("a.account_type").isin(["CREDIT", "CHECKING", "SAVINGS"]))
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("a.opened_date"),
        F.col("a.balance").alias("account_balance"),
        F.col("a.status"),
    )
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("running_max_balance").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

result = (
    latest
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("running_min_balance") >= 70000, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("running_min_balance_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "opened_date").alias("year_start"),

    .agg(

        F.avg(F.when(F.col("status") == "CLOSED", F.col("running_max_balance"))).alias("closed_avg_running_max_balance"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "CLOSED", 1)).alias("closed_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("frozen_balance") > 0)
)
```

```sql
    SELECT *, QUARTER(event_at) AS event_at_quarter
    FROM prepared_events

        t.actor AS event_actor,
        t.event_type AS event_event_type,
        t.event_at AS event_event_at
    FROM tagged s
    JOIN ticket_events t ON t.ticket_id = s.ticket_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach ticket_events metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MAX(t.event_at) FROM ticket_events t WHERE t.ticket_id = s.ticket_id) AS last_event_at,
        (SELECT MAX(t.event_at) FROM ticket_events t WHERE t.ticket_id = s.ticket_id) AS last_event_at_2
    FROM detail_rows_events s
),
unique_rows AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per ticket_id
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        actor,
        event_at_quarter,
        event_id,
        event_actor,
        event_event_type,
        event_event_at,
        last_event_at,
        last_event_at_2
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY last_event_at_2 DESC, id DESC, event_id DESC) AS row_num
        FROM summarized_rows
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    ticket_id,
    event_at_quarter,
    event_id,
    event_actor,
    event_event_type,
    event_event_at,
    last_event_at,
    last_event_at_2,
    COALESCE(event_at_quarter, 0) AS event_at_quarter_filled
FROM unique_rows
ORDER BY event_id
```

```python
prepared_events = (
    df_ticket_events
    .filter(F.col("event_at") >= F.lit("2025-01-31 08:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.concat(F.col("event_type"), F.lit("#"), F.col("ticket_id").cast("string")).alias("event_type_ref"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    prepared_events
    .filter(F.col("event_type_ref").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("event_at_quarter", F.quarter(F.col("event_at")))
)

detail_rows_events = (
    tagged.alias("s")
    .join(df_ticket_events.alias("t"), F.col("t.ticket_id") == F.col("s.ticket_id"), "inner")
    .select(

)

unique_rows = (
```

```sql
    SELECT status, MAX(premium_bucket) AS max_premium_bucket
    FROM derived
    GROUP BY status
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_premium_bucket,
        ROUND(s.premium_bucket - g.max_premium_bucket, 2) AS premium_bucket_minus_max
    FROM derived s
    JOIN status_stats g ON g.status = s.status
    WHERE s.premium_bucket = g.max_premium_bucket
)
SELECT
    id,
    holder_id,
    product,
    premium,
    product_group,
    premium_bucket,
    premium_filled,
    max_premium_bucket,
```

```sql
        account_id,

        is_flagged,
        CAST(is_flagged AS INT) is_flagged_flag,

),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,

        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_sum_amount,
        MAX(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_max_amount,
        MIN(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_min_amount
    FROM cleaned
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    SELECT s.*, p.opened_date
    FROM metrics s
    JOIN accounts p
        ON s.account_id = p.id
    WHERE p.customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY is_flagged_flag, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_count_amount,
        MAX(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY is_flagged_flag, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_max_amount_2,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY is_flagged_flag, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_avg_amount_2,
        LAST_VALUE(amount) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, merchant ORDER BY txn_time_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_amount
    FROM joined
)
SELECT
    id,
    account_id,
    txn_time,
    merchant,
    txn_time_date,
    opened_date,
    running_max_amount_2,
    running_avg_amount_2,
    last_known_amount,
    CASE WHEN merchant RLIKE '^(7-Eleven|Amazon)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN merchant RLIKE '^(Grab|Lazada)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS merchant_zone
FROM enriched
ORDER BY id, account_id
LIMIT 10;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        F.col("is_flagged").cast("int").alias("is_flagged_flag"),
        F.to_date("txn_time").alias("txn_time_date"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_amount"),
        F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_amount"),
        F.max("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_amount"),
        F.min("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_amount"),

        F.max("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("is_flagged_flag", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_amount_2"),
        F.avg("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("is_flagged_flag", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_amount_2"),
        F.last("amount", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("account_id", "merchant").orderBy("txn_time_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_amount"),
    )
)

result = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "txn_time_date",
```

```sql
        ROUND(SUM(country_avg_product_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Berlin' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS country_avg_product_id_per_berlin,
        SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Bangkok' THEN credit_limit ELSE 0 END) AS bangkok_credit_limit
    FROM with_windows_carts
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN country_avg_product_id >= 11 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
    HAVING MAX(age) > 0
)
SELECT
    country_avg_product_id_tier,
    corporate_rows,
    country_avg_product_id_per_berlin,
    bangkok_credit_limit
FROM summary
ORDER BY corporate_rows DESC;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("country")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("age")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("product_id_percent_rank").desc())

flattened = (
    df_carts
    .withColumn("li_item", F.explode_outer("items"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.col("li_item.product_id"),
        F.col("li_item.qty"),
        F.col("li_item.price"),
    )
)

joined = (
    flattened
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.customer_id",
        "a.coupon_codes",
        "a.product_id",
        "a.qty",
        F.col("d.country"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    joined
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isin([1, 3]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("qty").desc_nulls_last())).alias("qty_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("product_id").desc_nulls_last())).alias("product_id_percent_rank"),
        F.avg("product_id").over(w_running).alias("country_avg_product_id"),
    )
)

joined_carts = (
    with_windows
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.signup_date"), F.col("b.segment"), F.col("b.city"))
)

with_dims = (
    joined_carts
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("p.city").alias("customer_city"))
)

enriched = (
    with_dims
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("a.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("p.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.customer_id",
        "a.product_id_percent_rank",
        "a.country_avg_product_id",
        "a.segment",
        "a.city",
        F.col("p.age"),
        F.col("p.credit_limit"),
    )
)

with_windows_carts = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.stddev_samp("product_id_percent_rank").over(Window.partitionBy("segment", "city")).alias("segment_stddev_samp_product_id_percent_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w_hist).alias("age_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_ordered).alias("product_id_percent_rank_cume_dist"),
    )
)

summary = (
    with_windows_carts
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("country_avg_product_id") >= 11, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("country_avg_product_id_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("age").alias("max_age"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Corporate", 1)).alias("corporate_rows"),
        F.round(F.sum("country_avg_product_id") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Berlin", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("country_avg_product_id_per_berlin"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "Bangkok", F.col("credit_limit")).otherwise(0)).alias("bangkok_credit_limit"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("max_age") > 0)
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "country_avg_product_id_tier",
        "corporate_rows",
        "country_avg_product_id_per_berlin",
        "bangkok_credit_limit",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("corporate_rows").desc())
)
```

```sql
    from cleaned
```

```python
enriched = (
    df_inventory
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity",
        F.count("quantity").over(w_recent).alias("running_count_quantity"),
        F.max("quantity").over(w_recent).alias("running_max_quantity"),
        F.sum("quantity").over(w_recent).alias("running_sum_quantity"),

    )
)

    enriched
    .filter(F.col("quantity_avg_3").between(166, 204))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("quantity_avg_3") / F.nullif("running_sum_quantity", F.lit(0))).alias("quantity_avg_3_per_running_sum_quantity"),
    )
)

    .withColumn("running_count_quantity_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy("running_count_quantity")))
```

```sql
    FROM ticket_events

with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event_at per ticket_id

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        ticket_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(event_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY ticket_id, session_id
)
SELECT ticket_id, duration_min
FROM per_session
```

```sql
    quality,
    last_known_voltage,
    quality_slug,
    rows_in_voltage_tercile_quality,
    last_known_voltage_vs_voltage_tercile_quality_av,
    voltage_tercile_quartile,
    next_max_kwh_so_far,
    voltage_tercile_quality_min_kwh_sum_3,
    next_max_kwh_so_far + last_known_voltage AS next_max_kwh_so_far_plus_last_known_voltage,
    CONCAT_WS(': ', quality, quality_slug) AS quality_quality_slug_label
FROM with_trends
WHERE last_known_voltage BETWEEN 220.2 AND 240.2
ORDER BY voltage_tercile_quartile NULLS LAST, last_known_voltage, id
LIMIT 5
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter((F.month(F.col("read_at")).isin(2, 3)) & (F.col("voltage") > 216.1))
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
    )
)

w_site_id_quality_by_voltage = Window.partitionBy("site_id", "quality").orderBy(F.col("voltage").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w_quality = Window.partitionBy("quality")
windowed = (
    scoped
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "quality",
        F.ntile(3).over(w_site_id_quality_by_voltage).alias("voltage_tercile"),
        F.max("kwh").over(w_quality).alias("quality_max_kwh"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("site_id").over(w_quality)).alias("distinct_site_id_in_quality"),
        F.sum("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "quality").orderBy(F.col("voltage").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("kwh_sum_3"),
        F.last("voltage", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_voltage"),
        F.max("kwh").over(Window.orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_kwh_so_far"),
    )
)

scored = (
    windowed
    .select(
        "id",
        "quality",
        "voltage_tercile",
        "quality_max_kwh",
        "kwh_sum_3",
        "last_known_voltage",
        "max_kwh_so_far",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("quality")), " ", "_")).alias("quality_slug"),
        F.when(F.col("quality").isin("OK", "EST"), "group_a").when(F.col("quality") == "BAD", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("quality_group"),
    )
)

with_trends = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "quality",
        "last_known_voltage",
        "quality_slug",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("voltage_tercile", "quality")).alias("rows_in_voltage_tercile_quality"),
        F.first("max_kwh_so_far", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "quality_group").orderBy("voltage_tercile", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_max_kwh_so_far"),
        F.round(F.col("last_known_voltage") - F.avg("last_known_voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("voltage_tercile", "quality")), 2).alias("last_known_voltage_vs_voltage_tercile_quality_av"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "quality_group").orderBy("voltage_tercile", "id")).alias("voltage_tercile_quartile"),
        F.lead("max_kwh_so_far").over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "quality_group").orderBy("voltage_tercile", "id")).alias("next_max_kwh_so_far"),
        F.min("kwh_sum_3").over(Window.partitionBy("voltage_tercile", "quality")).alias("voltage_tercile_quality_min_kwh_sum_3"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_trends
    .filter(F.col("last_known_voltage").between(220.2, 240.2))
    .select(
        "id",
        "quality",
        "last_known_voltage",
        "quality_slug",
        "rows_in_voltage_tercile_quality",
        "last_known_voltage_vs_voltage_tercile_quality_av",
        "voltage_tercile_quartile",
        "next_max_kwh_so_far",
        "voltage_tercile_quality_min_kwh_sum_3",
        (F.col("next_max_kwh_so_far") + F.col("last_known_voltage")).alias("next_max_kwh_so_far_plus_last_known_voltage"),
        F.concat_ws(": ", F.col("quality"), F.col("quality_slug")).alias("quality_quality_slug_label"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("voltage_tercile_quartile").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("last_known_voltage").asc(),
        "id",
    )
    .limit(5)
)
```

```sql
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date DESC, id) AS row_num

        shipping_fee,
        row_num,
        LAG(amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipping_fee, id) AS prev_amount,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_recent AS discount_cume_dist,
        AVG(discount) OVER w_grp AS discount_avg_6
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(order_date), status ORDER BY discount DESC NULLS FIRST), w_grp AS (ORDER BY row_num, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY discount_cume_dist, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
deduped_orders AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, store_id ORDER BY rank_in_group DESC, id) AS rank_in_group_2
    FROM latest
    QUALIFY rank_in_group_2 = 1
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped_orders s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM payments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
              AND HOUR(c.paid_at) BETWEEN 12 AND 15
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    store_id,
    CASE WHEN prev_amount >= 1460 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS prev_amount_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(shipping_fee, 0.95) AS shipping_fee_p95,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pending_count
FROM eligible
GROUP BY store_id, CASE WHEN prev_amount >= 1460 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
ORDER BY shipping_fee_p95
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy(F.year("order_date"), "status").orderBy(F.col("discount").desc_nulls_first())
w_grp = Window.orderBy("row_num", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)

deduped = (
    df_orders
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("order_date").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "status",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        "shipping_fee",
        "row_num",
        F.lag("amount", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id")).alias("prev_amount"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_recent).alias("discount_cume_dist"),
        F.avg("discount").over(w_grp).alias("discount_avg_6"),
    )
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("discount_cume_dist", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

deduped_orders = (
    latest
    .withColumn("rank_in_group_2", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "store_id").orderBy(F.col("rank_in_group").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group_2") == 1)
)

eligible = (
    deduped_orders
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_payments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.hour(F.col("c.paid_at")).between(12, 15)), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    eligible
    .groupBy(
        "store_id",
        F.when(F.col("prev_amount") >= 1460, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("prev_amount_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("shipping_fee", 0.95).alias("shipping_fee_p95"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "PENDING", 1)).alias("pending_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("shipping_fee_p95")
)
```

```sql
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_all_by_commissioned_on AS commissioned_on_dense_rank
    FROM cleaned

leaders AS (

    FROM ranked

),
with_windows AS (

    FROM leaders
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        listener_id,
        track_id,
        played_at,
        device,
        source
    FROM plays
    WHERE track_id IS NOT NULL

with_prev AS (

    FROM prepared

flagged AS (

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY listener_id ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        listener_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(played_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(played_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY listener_id, burst_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    listener_id,
    burst_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
```

```sql
WITH joined_ranges AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.sku_id,
        a.moved_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_1d,
        SUM(b.qty) AS prior_qty_1d
    FROM stock_moves a
    LEFT JOIN stock_moves b
      ON b.sku_id = a.sku_id
     AND b.moved_at < a.moved_at
     AND b.moved_at >= a.moved_at - INTERVAL 1 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.sku_id, a.moved_at
),
sku_id_stats AS (
    -- Median prior_qty_1d per sku_id
    SELECT sku_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(prior_qty_1d, 0.5) AS median_prior_qty_1d
    FROM joined_ranges
    GROUP BY sku_id
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_prior_qty_1d,
        ROUND(s.prior_qty_1d - g.median_prior_qty_1d, 2) AS prior_qty_1d_minus_median
    FROM joined_ranges s
    JOIN sku_id_stats g ON g.sku_id = s.sku_id
    WHERE s.prior_qty_1d >= g.median_prior_qty_1d
)
SELECT
    id,
    sku_id,
    moved_at,
    prior_rows_1d,
    median_prior_qty_1d,
    ROUND(median_prior_qty_1d / NULLIF(prior_qty_1d, 0), 3) AS median_prior_qty_1d_per_prior_qty_1d,
    prior_qty_1d + prior_rows_1d AS prior_qty_1d_plus_prior_rows_1d
FROM vs_group
ORDER BY median_prior_qty_1d, id
LIMIT 5
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

joined_ranges = (
    df_stock_moves.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_stock_moves.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.sku_id") == F.col("a.sku_id"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") < F.col("a.moved_at"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") >= F.col("a.moved_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.sku_id", "a.moved_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_1d"),
        F.sum("b.qty").alias("prior_qty_1d"),
    )
)

sku_id_stats = (
    joined_ranges
    .groupBy("sku_id")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("prior_qty_1d", 0.5).alias("median_prior_qty_1d"))
)

vs_group = (
    joined_ranges.alias("s")
    .join(sku_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.sku_id") == F.col("s.sku_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.prior_qty_1d") >= F.col("g.median_prior_qty_1d"))

        "g.median_prior_qty_1d",

    )
)

result = (
    vs_group
    .select(
        "id",
        "sku_id",
        "moved_at",
        "prior_rows_1d",
        "median_prior_qty_1d",
        F.round(F.col("median_prior_qty_1d") / F.nullif(F.col("prior_qty_1d"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("median_prior_qty_1d_per_prior_qty_1d"),
        (F.col("prior_qty_1d") + F.col("prior_rows_1d")).alias("prior_qty_1d_plus_prior_rows_1d"),
```

```sql
        SUM(amount) OVER w_part_2 AS cumulative_amount,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY amount DESC, id ASC) AS amount_bucket_2
    FROM transactions
    WHERE is_flagged

gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_txn_time IS NULL OR txn_time > prev_txn_time + INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        actor,
        burst_id,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(event_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY actor, burst_id
),
qualified AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM session_summary
    WHERE event_count > (SELECT AVG(event_count) FROM session_summary)
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM qualified
    WHERE burst_id > (SELECT AVG(burst_id) FROM qualified)
)

    session_end,
    event_count,
    CONCAT(actor, '#', CAST(burst_id AS STRING)) AS actor_ref
FROM without_matches
```

```python
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("event_type")), 1, 3).alias("event_type_prefix"),
    )
)

with_prev = recent_events.withColumn("prev_event_at", F.lag("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("actor").orderBy("event_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_event_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("event_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_event_at")) / 60 > 30), 1).otherwise(0))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time_date", "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy(F.col("event_time_date").desc(), "id")

valid = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("event_time") >= F.lit("2023-10-01").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        F.ceil("duration_sec").alias("duration_sec_whole"),
        F.to_date("event_time").alias("event_time_date"),

)

metrics = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("duration_sec_whole").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("duration_sec_whole", "id")).alias("prev_duration_sec_whole"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("duration_sec_whole", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.avg("duration_sec_whole").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "event_time"), "page").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)).alias("duration_sec_whole_avg_7d"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "event_time_date",
        "page_clean",
        "prev_duration_sec_whole",
        "row_seq",
        "duration_sec_whole_avg_7d",
        F.lead("prev_duration_sec_whole", 1).over(w_recent).alias("next_prev_duration_sec_whole"),
        F.sum("duration_sec_whole_avg_7d").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)).alias("duration_sec_whole_avg_7d_sum_7d"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("event_seq"),
        F.lead("duration_sec_whole", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("duration_sec_whole_avg_7d", "id")).alias("next_duration_sec_whole"),
        F.count("duration_sec_whole").over(Window.partitionBy("page")).alias("page_count_duration_sec_whole"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    scored
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

    with_gaps
    .select(

        "event_time_date",
        "page_clean",
        "row_seq",
        "page_count_duration_sec_whole",

)

)

sessions_web_events = flagged.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

prev_events = sessions_web_events.withColumn("prev_event_time", F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")))

gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_event_time").isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.col("prev_event_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized_web_events = gaps.withColumn("burst_id_2", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

with_windows = (

    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("row_seq", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_row_seq"),
        F.avg("island_id").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "event_time"), "page").orderBy("session_start_flag", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("island_id_avg_2"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("event_seq"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy(F.col("is_new_burst").asc_nulls_last())).alias("is_new_burst_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "page",
        "event_time_date",
        "page_clean",
        "row_seq",
        "page_count_duration_sec_whole",
        "is_new_burst",
        "island_id",
        "prev_event_time",
    )
)
```

```python
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w_ordered))

    .withColumn("method_upper", F.upper("method"))

    .filter(F.col("d.store_id").isNull())

    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("e.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("b.id")), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.discount").alias("order_discount"), F.col("b.order_date"))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_plays

        "ms_played",
        "is_skipped",
        "source",
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("is_skipped"))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.floor(F.col("ms_played") / 50000) * 50000).alias("ms_played_bucket"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("ms_played"), F.lit(0)).alias("ms_played_filled"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("source"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("source_or_unknown"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored.alias("s")
    .join(df_tracks.alias("t"), F.col("t.id") == F.col("s.track_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.listener_id",
        "s.track_id",
        "s.played_at",
        "s.ms_played",
        "s.source",
        "s.ms_played_bucket",
        "s.source_or_unknown",
        F.col("t.is_explicit").alias("track_is_explicit"),
        F.col("t.moods").alias("track_moods"),

)

play_stats = (

    .groupBy("track_id")
    .agg(

summarized_rows = (
```

```python
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc())).alias("discount_pct_dense_rank"),
```

```sql
WITH paid_monthly AS (
    -- PAID rows per claim_date_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date) AS claim_date_month, COUNT(*) AS paid_count, ROUND(AVG(claimed_amount), 2) AS paid_avg_claimed_amount
    FROM claims
    WHERE status = 'PAID'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date)
),
open_monthly AS (
    -- OPEN rows per claim_date_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date) AS claim_date_month, COUNT(*) AS open_count, SUM(claimed_amount) AS open_total_claimed_amount
    FROM claims
    WHERE status = 'OPEN'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.claim_date_month, b.claim_date_month) AS claim_date_month,
    COALESCE(a.paid_count, 0) AS paid_count,
    COALESCE(a.paid_avg_claimed_amount, 0) AS paid_avg_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(b.open_count, 0) AS open_count,
    b.open_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.paid_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.open_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM paid_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN open_monthly b
  ON a.claim_date_month = b.claim_date_month
ORDER BY claim_date_month
```

```python
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status") == "PAID")

    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("paid_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("claimed_amount"), 2).alias("paid_avg_claimed_amount"),
    )
)

open_monthly = (
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status") == "OPEN")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date").alias("claim_date_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("open_count"),
        F.sum("claimed_amount").alias("open_total_claimed_amount"),
    )
)

    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.claim_date_month"), F.col("b.claim_date_month")).alias("claim_date_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.paid_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("paid_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.paid_avg_claimed_amount"), F.lit(0)).alias("paid_avg_claimed_amount"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.open_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("open_count"),
        F.col("b.open_total_claimed_amount"),
```

```python
base = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull() & (~F.col("page").eqNullSafe(F.lit("/cart"))))
    .withColumn("event_type_upper", F.upper("event_type"))
    .withColumn("page_group", F.when(F.col("page").isin(["/cart", "/search"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other"))
)

prev_events = base.withColumn("prev_event_time", F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")))

with_gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_event_time").isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.col("prev_event_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))

        "event_type",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        "page_group",
```

```python
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("status", "method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_payments
    .filter(~F.col("status").isin(["REFUNDED", "SUCCESS"]) & (~F.col("method").eqNullSafe(F.lit("promptpay"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.concat_ws("-", "method", "status").alias("method_status_key"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("method_filled"),
    )
)

cleaned_payments = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2023-05-20").cast("date")))
    .select("*", F.lower("method").alias("method_lower"))
)

        "method",
        "paid_at",

    )
)

result = (
    sessions_payments

        "method",
        "paid_at",
```

```sql
WITH base AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        warehouse_id,
        sku_id,
        move_type,

        operator,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', moved_at) AS days_since_moved_at,

    FROM stock_moves
    WHERE unit_price >= 130.6
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach stock_moves metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(st.unit_price) FROM stock_moves st WHERE st.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id) AS min_move_unit_price,
        (SELECT MAX(st.moved_at) FROM stock_moves st WHERE st.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id) AS last_moved_at,
        (SELECT MIN(st.moved_at) FROM stock_moves st WHERE st.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id) AS first_moved_at
    FROM base s
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    move_type,
    warehouse_id,
    SUM(days_since_moved_at) AS total_days_since_moved_at,
    MAX(moved_at) AS last_moved_at_2,
    COUNT(DISTINCT move_type) AS distinct_move_types
FROM summarized_rows
GROUP BY CUBE(move_type, warehouse_id)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_stock_moves
    .filter(F.col("unit_price") >= 130.6)
    .select(
        "id",
        "warehouse_id",
        "sku_id",
        "move_type",
        "qty",
        "moved_at",
        "operator",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("moved_at")).alias("days_since_moved_at"),
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("move_type")), " ", "_")).alias("move_type_slug"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("unit_price"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("unit_price_filled"),
    )
)

move_stats = (
    df_stock_moves
    .groupBy("warehouse_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("unit_price").alias("min_move_unit_price"),
        F.max("moved_at").alias("last_moved_at"),
        F.min("moved_at").alias("first_moved_at"),
    )
)

)

    .agg(
```

```sql
        id,
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        closed_at,
        priority,
        channel,
        csat,
        tags
    FROM tickets
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous closed_at per channel
    SELECT *, LAG(closed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY closed_at, id) AS prev_closed_at
    FROM filtered
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_closed_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(closed_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_closed_at)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY closed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach tickets metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(t.requester_id) FROM tickets t WHERE t.agent_id = s.agent_id) AS min_ticket_requester_id
    FROM sessionized s
),
derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        requester_id,
        closed_at,
        csat,
        tags,
        session_id,
        min_ticket_requester_id,
        CASE WHEN priority IN ('P4', 'P2') THEN 'group_a' WHEN priority = 'P3' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS priority_group,
        QUARTER(prev_closed_at) AS prev_closed_at_quarter,
        CASE WHEN channel IN ('email', 'phone') THEN 'group_a' WHEN channel = 'web' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS channel_group
    FROM summarized_rows
)
SELECT
    prev_closed_at_quarter,
    priority_group,
    session_id,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid,
    ROUND(SUM(prev_closed_at_quarter) / NULLIF(SUM(csat), 0), 3) AS prev_closed_at_quarter_to_csat_ratio,
    COUNT(DISTINCT priority_group) AS distinct_priority_groups,
    SUM(requester_id) AS total_requester_id
FROM derived
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((prev_closed_at_quarter, priority_group, session_id), (prev_closed_at_quarter))
ORDER BY prev_closed_at_quarter NULLS LAST, priority_group NULLS LAST, session_id NULLS LAST
```

```python
    .select(
        "id",
        "requester_id",

        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "csat",
        "tags",
    )
)

with_prev = filtered.withColumn("prev_closed_at", F.lag("closed_at").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("closed_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_closed_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("closed_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_closed_at")) / 60 > 60), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("closed_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

ticket_stats = (
    df_tickets
    .groupBy("agent_id")
    .agg(F.min("requester_id").alias("min_ticket_requester_id"))
)

summarized_rows = (
    sessionized.alias("s")
    .join(ticket_stats.alias("t"), F.col("t.agent_id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "left")

    )

    )
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
        F.round(F.sum("prev_closed_at_quarter") / F.nullif(F.sum("csat"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("prev_closed_at_quarter_to_csat_ratio"),
        F.countDistinct("priority_group").alias("distinct_priority_groups"),
        F.sum("requester_id").alias("total_requester_id"),
    )
    .orderBy(
```

```sql
    FROM cleaned_enrollments

    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_enrolled_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(enrolled_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_enrolled_at)) / 60 > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
grade_status_stats AS (
    -- Max new_session_flag per grade_status
    SELECT grade_status, MAX(new_session_flag) AS max_new_session_flag
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY grade_status
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_new_session_flag,
        ROUND(s.new_session_flag - g.max_new_session_flag, 2) AS new_session_flag_minus_max
    FROM sessionized s
    JOIN grade_status_stats g ON g.grade_status = s.grade_status
    WHERE s.new_session_flag = g.max_new_session_flag
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach enrollments metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.course_id = s.course_id) AS enrollment_count,
        (SELECT MAX(e.enrolled_at) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.course_id = s.course_id) AS last_enrollment_enrolled_at
    FROM outliers s
)

    burst_id,
    course_id,
    enrollment_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE grade_status IN ('PASS', 'WITHDRAWN', 'INCOMPLETE')) AS n_grade_status_in_pass_withdra
FROM profiled
```

```python
    df_customers
    .filter(F.upper(F.trim("email")) == "GRACE.KIM@GMAIL.COM")
    .select(

        "name",
        "email",
        "country",
        "city",
        "signup_date",
        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        F.trim("country").alias("clean_country"),
    )

with_windows = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("name").like("b%"))
```

```python
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("prev_cost", "id")

    df_products

    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "brand", "cost", "stock_qty")
)

with_windows = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("next_cost", F.lead("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("stock_qty", "id")))
    .withColumn("prev_cost", F.lag("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("stock_qty", "id")))
    .withColumn("next_stock_qty", F.lead("stock_qty").over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("stock_qty", "id")))
    .withColumn("prev_stock_qty", F.lag("stock_qty").over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("stock_qty", "id")))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("stock_qty", "id")))
)

with_windows_products = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("next_cost").between(210, 710))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("stock_qty").over(w_recent).alias("prev_stock_qty_2"),
        F.lead("stock_qty").over(w_recent).alias("next_stock_qty_2"),
        F.lag("prev_cost").over(w_recent).alias("prev_prev_cost"),
        F.lead("prev_cost").over(w_recent).alias("next_prev_cost"),
        F.row_number().over(w_recent).alias("row_seq_2"),
        F.first("prev_cost", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("stock_qty", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_prev_cost"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    with_windows_products
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("row_seq_2", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "brand",
        "prev_cost",
        "next_stock_qty",
        "prev_stock_qty",
        "prev_stock_qty_2",
        "next_stock_qty_2",
        "next_prev_cost",
        "row_seq_2",
    )
)

    ranked
    .withColumn("running_sum_prev_cost", F.sum("prev_cost").over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("prev_stock_qty_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_avg_prev_cost", F.avg("prev_cost").over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("prev_stock_qty_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("running_min_prev_cost", F.min("prev_cost").over(Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("prev_stock_qty_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
```

```sql
        ROUND(status_count_amount / SUM(status_count_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(shipped_date), status), 4) AS status_count_amount_share,
```

```python
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("shipped_date", "id")

    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("carrier").isNotNull() & (~F.col("carrier").eqNullSafe(F.lit("UPS"))))
    .select("*", F.length("status").alias("status_length"))
)

enriched = (
    base
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("e.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("d.id")), "inner")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.order_id",

        "e.status",
        "e.status_length",
        F.col("d.amount"),
        F.col("d.shipping_fee"),
    )

    enriched
    .filter(F.col("amount") <= 480)
    .select(
```

```sql
        max(city_sum_rating) as max_city_sum_rating,

select
```

```python
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.stock_qty").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(

)

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
```

```python
    df_sites
    .filter(F.col("commissioned_on") >= F.lit("2024-09-15").cast("date"))

        "tariff",
        "installed_kw",

)

per_group = (
    base
    .groupBy("zone", "site_name_len")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("zone").alias("distinct_zones"),
        F.count(F.when(F.length(F.trim(F.col("site_name"))) >= 4, 1)).alias("n_length_trim_site_name_4"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("site_name")).alias("site_name_list"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("zone").isin("Z4", "Z2"), F.col("installed_kw")).otherwise(0)).alias("installed_kw_zone_in_z4_z2"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    per_group
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("installed_kw_zone_in_z4_z2", 3).over(Window.partitionBy("cnt", "n_length_trim_site_name_4").orderBy("distinct_zones", "zone", "site_name_len")).alias("prev3_installed_kw_zone_in_z4_z2"),

    )
)

labeled = (

    .filter(F.col("installed_kw_zone_in_z4_z2") >= 250.0)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("zone"))).alias("zone_len"),
        F.when(F.col("distinct_zones") >= 6, "HIGH").when(F.col("distinct_zones") >= 5, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("distinct_zones_tier"),
        (F.col("distinct_zones") - F.col("cnt")).alias("distinct_zones_minus_cnt"),
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY quality ORDER BY read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id

),
quality_stats AS (

above_average AS (

    SELECT

        g.avg_new_session_flag,

with_details AS (
```

```sql
not_flagged as (

)
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
```

```sql
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY track_id ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
play_stats AS (
    -- Per-track plays metrics
    SELECT
        track_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN source = 'search' THEN 1 END) AS play_source_count,
        COUNT(*) AS play_count
    FROM plays
    GROUP BY track_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach plays metrics

        s.*,

    FROM sessionized s
```

```sql
        SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY last_restock, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last3_sum_sqft,

)
```

```python
    df_inventory
    .alias("e")

    .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= F.lit("2023-02-23").cast("date"))

        "product_id",
```

```sql
scored AS (
```

```sql
    FROM with_parent_listener

deduped AS (

    SELECT
```

```sql
with_gaps AS (

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(web_event_event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY web_event_event_time ASC, id ASC) IS NULL
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.bad_count, 0) AS bad_count,
    b.bad_total_kwh,
    COALESCE(a.est_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.bad_count, 0) AS est_count_minus_bad_count
FROM est_by_site a
FULL OUTER JOIN bad_by_site b

ORDER BY site_id
```

```python
est_by_site = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("quality") == "EST")
    .groupBy("site_id")

        F.count("*").alias("est_count"),

bad_by_site = (

    .filter(F.col("quality") == "BAD")
    .groupBy("site_id")
```

```sql
    FROM sessions
```
