),
gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN started_at - LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id) > INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM filtered
),
sessions_sessions AS (

    FROM gaps
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN session_id >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS session_id_tier,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN browser = 'Safari' THEN 1 END) AS safari_count,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(started_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(started_at))) / 60 AS span_minutes,
    COUNT_IF(device = 'desktop') AS desktop_events
FROM sessions_sessions
GROUP BY 1
HAVING safari_count >= 1
ORDER BY session_id_tier DESC;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("country") == "JP")
    .select("*", F.lower("browser").alias("browser_lower"))
)

gaps = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("started_at") - F.lag("started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', enrolled_at) AS enrolled_at_month, COUNT(*) AS fail_count, ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS fail_avg_score

withdrawn_monthly AS (

    FROM enrollments
    WHERE grade_status = 'WITHDRAWN'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', enrolled_at)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.enrolled_at_month, b.enrolled_at_month) AS enrolled_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.fail_count, 0) AS fail_count,
    COALESCE(a.fail_avg_score, 0) AS fail_avg_score,
    COALESCE(b.withdrawn_count, 0) AS withdrawn_count,
    COALESCE(b.withdrawn_total_score, 0) AS withdrawn_total_score,
    COALESCE(a.fail_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.withdrawn_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM fail_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN withdrawn_monthly b
  ON a.enrolled_at_month = b.enrolled_at_month
ORDER BY enrolled_at_month

    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("grade_status") == "FAIL")

    .agg(

    )
)

    .join(withdrawn_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.enrolled_at_month") == F.col("b.enrolled_at_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.enrolled_at_month"), F.col("b.enrolled_at_month")).alias("enrolled_at_month"),

    .withColumn("device_code_lower", F.lower("device_code"))
)

ranked = (
    base
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("status_bits")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

ranked_device_readings = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)

        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",

        PERCENTILE_APPROX(quantity, 0.9) AS quantity_p90,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        BIT_AND(quantity) AS quantity_bit_and
    FROM cleaned

)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent_agents = (
    df_support_agents

    .select(
        "id",
        "agent_name",
        "team",
        "tier",
        "hired_on",
        F.date_format(F.col("hired_on"), "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("hired_on_label"),
        F.when(F.col("team").isin("Billing", "Tech"), "group_a").when(F.col("team") == "VIP", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("team_group"),
    )
)

w_team_group_tier_by_hired_on_2 = Window.partitionBy("team_group", "tier").orderBy("hired_on")
w_team_group_by_hired_on = Window.partitionBy("team_group").orderBy("hired_on", "id")
w_team_group_tier_by_hired_on_3 = Window.partitionBy("team_group", "tier").orderBy("hired_on", "id")
w_all_by_hired_on = Window.orderBy(F.col("hired_on").desc(), "id")
metrics = (
    recent_agents
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("team_group").orderBy("hired_on", "id")), 3).alias("hired_on_cume_dist"),
        F.nth_value("hired_on", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("team_group", "tier").orderBy("hired_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_hired_on"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_team_group_tier_by_hired_on_2).alias("hired_on_dense_rank"),
        F.last("hired_on").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("hired_on").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_hired_on"),
        F.lead("hired_on", 3).over(w_team_group_by_hired_on).alias("next3_hired_on"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("team_group", "tier").orderBy("hired_on", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w_team_group_tier_by_hired_on_3).alias("hired_on_decile"),
        F.last("hired_on", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("team_group", "tier").orderBy("hired_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_hired_on"),
        F.lag("hired_on").over(w_team_group_by_hired_on).alias("prev_hired_on"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("team_group", "tier").orderBy("hired_on")), 3).alias("hired_on_cume_dist_2"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("hired_on").desc(), "id")), 3).alias("hired_on_cume_dist_3"),
        F.nth_value("hired_on", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("team_group").orderBy("hired_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_hired_on_2"),
        F.lag("hired_on").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("hired_on").desc(), "id")).alias("prev_hired_on_2"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w_all_by_hired_on).alias("hired_on_decile_2"),

w_prev_hired_on_month = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "prev_hired_on"))
w_team_by_hired_on_cume_dist = Window.partitionBy("team").orderBy(F.col("hired_on_cume_dist").desc(), "id")
ranked = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w_team_by_hired_on_cume_dist_t).alias("hired_on_cume_dist_dense_rank"),
        F.lead("second_hired_on").over(Window.partitionBy("team").orderBy(F.col("seq_no").desc(), "id")).alias("next_second_hired_on"),

        F.sum("hired_on_cume_dist_2").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "prev_hired_on"))).alias("prev_hired_on_month_sum_hired_on_cume_dist_2"),
        F.lag("last_hired_on", 3).over(Window.partitionBy("team").orderBy(F.col("seq_no").desc(), "id")).alias("prev3_last_hired_on"),
        F.lag("hired_on", 2).over(w_team_by_hired_on_cume_dist).alias("prev2_hired_on"),
    )
)

result = (

        "team",
        "hired_on",
        "hired_on_label",
        "team_group",
        "hired_on_cume_dist",
        "second_hired_on",

        "hired_on_cume_dist_2",

        "prev_hired_on_2",
        "hired_on_decile_2",
        "hired_on_cume_dist_dense_rank",
        "next_second_hired_on",

        "prev_hired_on_month_sum_hired_on_cume_dist_2",
        "prev3_last_hired_on",

    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        attr_key,
        value
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(attributes) t AS attr_key, value
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        attr_key,
        value,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), created_at) AS days_since_created_at,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'NONE') AS attr_key_clean
    FROM flattened
    WHERE created_at < '2023-07-11'
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY days_since_created_at DESC, id, attr_key) AS rank_in_group
        FROM filtered
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        value,
        days_since_created_at,
        rank_in_group,
        MIN(days_since_created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, attr_key ORDER BY rank_in_group, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_min_days_since_created_at,
        MAX(days_since_created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, attr_key ORDER BY rank_in_group, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_max_days_since_created_at,
        SUM(days_since_created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, attr_key ORDER BY rank_in_group, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_sum_days_since_created_at
    FROM deduped
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN last3_sum_days_since_created_at >= 350 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS last3_sum_days_since_created_at_tier,
    attr_key,
    COUNT_IF(attr_key = 'weight_kg') AS weight_kg_events,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(days_since_created_at, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS days_since_created_at_quartiles,
    COUNT_IF(attr_key = 'utm_source') AS utm_source_events
FROM enriched
GROUP BY CASE WHEN last3_sum_days_since_created_at >= 350 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, attr_key
ORDER BY last3_sum_days_since_created_at_tier DESC NULLS FIRST

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCESS', 'REFUNDED') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END AS status_group
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at > TIMESTAMP '2023-11-05 17:00:00'

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) + INTERVAL 14 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM base
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN paid_at - LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id) > INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session_2
    FROM islands
),
islands_payments AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session_2) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) + INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM islands_payments
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,

        is_new_session,
        SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM gaps

scored AS (

scored AS (

        SUM(event_seq) OVER w_ordered AS cumulative_event_seq,

    CASE WHEN cumulative_event_seq >= 39 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS cumulative_event_seq_tier,

    ROUND(AVG(adjusted_last_known_event_seq), 2) AS avg_adjusted_last_known_event_seq,
    MIN(event_seq_2) AS min_event_seq_2,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN cumulative_event_seq >= 39 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END ORDER BY MIN(event_seq_2) DESC) AS min_event_seq_2_percent_rank

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_dims = (
    df_transactions
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("p"), F.col("src.account_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("src.id", "src.account_id", "src.txn_time", F.col("p.account_type"))
)

with_windows = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.first("account_type", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_account_type"),
        F.last("account_type", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("account_id", "account_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_account_type"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("txn_time").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq_2"),
        F.first("account_type", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("txn_time"), "account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_account_type_2"),
    )

scored = (

    .filter(F.col("event_seq") < 4)
    .withColumn("cumulative_event_seq", F.sum("event_seq").over(w_ordered))

)

valid = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("event_seq_2") != 7)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("last_known_event_seq") * 100), 2).alias("adjusted_last_known_event_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("cumulative_event_seq") >= 39, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("cumulative_event_seq_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("event_seq") >= 8, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("event_seq_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("adjusted_last_known_event_seq"), 2).alias("avg_adjusted_last_known_event_seq"),
        F.min("event_seq_2").alias("min_event_seq_2"),
    )
    .withColumn("min_event_seq_2_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("cumulative_event_seq_tier").orderBy(F.col("min_event_seq_2").desc())))

        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.date_format("paid_at", "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("paid_at_label"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("unassigned")).alias("method_filled"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("paid_at") - F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

    .select("id", "method", "status", "paid_at_label", "seq_no", "session_no_sum_30d")

scored AS (

        device,
        source,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', played_at) AS played_at_month,
        played_at + INTERVAL 1 DAYS AS played_at_plus_1d,
        YEAR(played_at) AS played_at_year
    FROM cleaned_plays
    WHERE source = 'radio'
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    track_id,
    source,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid,
    ROUND(AVG(played_at_year), 2) AS avg_played_at_year,
    MIN(played_at_year) AS min_played_at_year
FROM scored
GROUP BY CUBE(track_id, source)
ORDER BY track_id NULLS LAST, source NULLS LAST
```

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned_plays = (
    df_plays
    .filter(F.col("track_id") >= 15)
    .select(
        "id",
        "listener_id",
        "track_id",
        "played_at",
        "device",
        "source",
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned_plays
    .filter(F.col("source") == "radio")

        "listener_id",
        "track_id",

    FROM flagged
)

    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at) AS read_at_month, COUNT(*) AS est_count, SUM(kwh) AS est_total_kwh
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE quality = 'EST'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at)

bad_monthly AS (

    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE quality = 'BAD'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.read_at_month, b.read_at_month) AS read_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.est_count, 0) AS est_count,
    COALESCE(a.est_total_kwh, 0) AS est_total_kwh,
    COALESCE(b.bad_count, 0) AS bad_count,
    b.bad_total_kwh,
    COALESCE(a.est_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.bad_count, 0) AS est_count_minus_bad_count
FROM est_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN bad_monthly b
  ON a.read_at_month = b.read_at_month
ORDER BY read_at_month
```

    df_meter_readings

        F.coalesce(F.col("a.est_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("est_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.est_total_kwh"), F.lit(0)).alias("est_total_kwh"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.bad_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("bad_count"),
        F.col("b.bad_total_kwh"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.est_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.bad_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("est_count_minus_bad_count"),

        F.coalesce("promo", F.lit("NONE")).alias("promo_filled"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("promo").orderBy(F.col("product_id").asc_nulls_last())).alias("product_id_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("promo").orderBy(F.col("qty_sum_1h").desc_nulls_last())).alias("qty_sum_1h_cume_dist"),
        F.max("product_id").over(Window.partitionBy("promo").orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)).alias("product_id_max_2h"),
    )
)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

gaps = (
    df_device_readings
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))

    .intersectAll(

        .filter(F.col("status_bits") <= 11)

    .alias("s")

SELECT

        MIN(voltage) OVER w_site_id AS site_id_min_voltage,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY read_at_week DESC, id) AS read_at_week_decile,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(quality) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id)) AS distinct_quality_in_site_id,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id) AS rows_in_site_id,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_site_id_by_kwh_ties AS kwh_dense_rank
    FROM filtered_readings

per_group AS (

        MIN(max_kwh_so_far) AS min_max_kwh_so_far,

    FROM windowed
    WHERE site_id >= 5

),
with_trends AS (

    FROM per_group
    WINDOW w_n_quality_not_in_est_bad_sit AS (PARTITION BY n_quality_not_in_est_bad, site_id ORDER BY min_max_kwh_so_far, site_id)
)

        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.date_trunc("week", F.col("read_at")).alias("read_at_week"),
    )
)

w_site_id = Window.partitionBy("site_id")
w_site_id_by_kwh_ties = Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("kwh")
windowed = (
    filtered_readings
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.avg("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id")), 2).alias("site_id_avg_voltage"),
        F.first("read_at_week").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_read_at_week"),
        F.max("kwh").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at_week").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_kwh_so_far"),

    )
)

w_n_quality_not_in_est_bad_sit = Window.partitionBy("n_quality_not_in_est_bad", "site_id").orderBy("min_max_kwh_so_far", "site_id")
with_trends = (

    select *, ceil(amount) as amount_whole
    from payments
    where order_id is not null
      and method != 'card'

    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        status,
        amount_whole
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by method, status order by amount asc, id asc) as dedup_rank
        from valid
    ) x
    where dedup_rank = 1
),
deduped_payments as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from deduped
    qualify row_number() over (partition by status order by amount_whole desc, id asc) = 1
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select src.*, o.order_date
    from deduped_payments src
    join orders o
        on src.order_id = o.id
    where o.shipping_fee between 13 and 21
),
summary as (
    -- Grouped metrics
    select
        case when amount_whole >= 83 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as amount_whole_tier,
        order_id,
        round(sum(amount) / nullif(count(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 end), 0), 2) as amount_per_failed,
        count(distinct id) as distinct_ids,
        count(*) as event_count,
        grouping(case when amount_whole >= 83 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end) as grouping_level
    from enriched
    group by grouping sets ((case when amount_whole >= 83 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end, order_id), (case when amount_whole >= 83 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end))
)
select
    s.amount_whole_tier,
    s.order_id,
    s.amount_per_failed,
    s.distinct_ids,
    s.event_count,
    s.grouping_level,
    (select min(t2.cost) from shipments t2 where t2.order_id = s.order_id) as min_shipment_cost
from summary s
order by min_shipment_cost desc nulls last

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("method") != "card"))
    .select("*", F.ceil("amount").alias("amount_whole"))
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("method", "status").orderBy("amount", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "order_id", "amount", "status", "amount_whole")
)

deduped_payments = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("amount_whole").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

enriched = (
    deduped_payments
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("o.shipping_fee").between(13, 21))

)

    enriched
    .withColumn("amount_whole_tier", F.when(F.col("amount_whole") >= 83, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .groupingSets(

        "amount_whole_tier",
        "order_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("amount") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "FAILED", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("amount_per_failed"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.grouping("amount_whole_tier").alias("grouping_level"),
    )

    .join(cost_by_order_id, on="order_id", how="left")

        "order_id",
        "amount_per_failed",
        "distinct_ids",
        "event_count",

w_hist = Window.orderBy("prev_prev_balance", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w_grp = Window.orderBy("prev_balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_windows = (
    df_accounts
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("balance").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("balance", "id")).alias("prev_balance"),
        F.lead("balance").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("balance", "id")).alias("next_balance"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("balance", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.account_id").isin([5, 17, 19, 34])), "left_anti")
)

with_last = (
    not_flagged
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.amount").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.account_type",
        "s.balance",
        "s.opened_date",
        "s.status",
        "s.prev_balance",
        F.col("c.txn_time").alias("transaction_txn_time"),
    )
)

with_windows_accounts = (
    with_last
    .select(
        "id",
        "prev_balance",
        F.lag("balance").over(w_ordered).alias("prev_balance_2"),
        F.lag("prev_balance").over(w_ordered).alias("prev_prev_balance"),
        F.lead("prev_balance").over(w_ordered).alias("next_prev_balance"),
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

not_flagged_accounts = (
    with_windows_accounts
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.is_flagged")), "left_anti")
)

eligible = (

    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.merchant") == "Shell"), "left_anti")

        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY SIZE(COLLECT_SET(plan)) DESC) AS num_plans_percent_rank
    FROM enriched

        *,

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("humidity", "id")
w_running = Window.orderBy("running_avg_temp_c_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

metrics = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("status_bits") < 4)
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "status_bits",
        F.avg("temp_c").over(w_ordered).alias("running_avg_temp_c"),
        F.min("temp_c").over(w_ordered).alias("running_min_temp_c"),
        F.sum("temp_c").over(w_ordered).alias("running_sum_temp_c"),
        F.lag("humidity", 1).over(w_hist).alias("prev_humidity"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("status_bits").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

deduped = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "prev_humidity",

        F.sum("status_bits").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("reading_ts"))).alias("reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("running_avg_temp_c").desc(), "id")).alias("running_avg_temp_c_bucket"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "prev_humidity",
        "cumulative_running_avg_temp_c",
        "running_avg_temp_c_bucket",
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("prev_humidity").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.last("prev_humidity", ignorenulls=True).over(w_running).alias("last_known_prev_humidity"),
        F.sum("reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits").over(Window.orderBy("cumulative_running_avg_temp_c", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits"),

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("device_code") == "DV-03")
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        F.when(F.col("pressure") >= 1029, "High").when(F.col("pressure") >= 988, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("pressure_level"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "pressure",
        "pressure_level",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

gaps_2 = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized_device_readings = gaps_2.withColumn("burst_id_2", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

latest = (
    sessionized_device_readings
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

latest_device_readings = (
    latest
    .withColumn("row_num_2", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("burst_id").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num_2") == 1)
)

flagged = (
    latest_device_readings
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 1 HOUR")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_device_readings = flagged.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

result = (
    sessions_device_readings
    .groupBy("burst_id", F.date_trunc("HOUR", "reading_ts").alias("hour_window"))
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("device_code")).alias("num_device_codes"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.round(F.avg("burst_id"), 2).alias("avg_burst_id"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-01", 1)).alias("dv_01_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("burst_id").desc())
)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("is_new_burst").desc(), "id")

latest = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("method", "status").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

gaps = (
    latest
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

metrics = (
    islands
    .withColumn("last7_sum_amount", F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy("session_no", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("last7_max_amount", F.max("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy("session_no", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("last7_avg_amount", F.avg("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy("session_no", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)))
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("last7_sum_amount", ignorenulls=True).over(w_part).alias("last_known_last7_sum_amount"),
        F.sum("last7_avg_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id")).alias("order_id_sum_last7_avg_amount"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w_recent).alias("is_new_burst_bucket"),
    )
)

with_prev = with_windows.withColumn("prev_paid_at", F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_paid_at").isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.col("prev_paid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands_payments = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "is_new_burst",
        "last7_sum_amount",
        "last_known_last7_sum_amount",
        "order_id_sum_last7_avg_amount",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),

    islands_payments
    .select("id")

        .filter(F.col("amount") > 990)
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    islands_payments
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

totals = (
    reconciled
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("last7_sum_amount") >= 9000, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("last7_sum_amount_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "paid_at").alias("quarter_start"),

    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),

        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("method")).alias("method_list"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "last7_sum_amount_tier",
        "quarter_start",
        "avg_order_id_sum_last7_avg_amount",
        "started_at",
        "num_methods",
        "method_list",

    .select("*", F.year("reading_ts").alias("reading_ts_year"))
)

    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))

        "humidity",

    )

    islands

    SELECT
        id,
        warehouse_id,
        sku_id,
        move_type,
        moved_at,
        unit_price
    FROM stock_moves
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous moved_at per move_type
    SELECT *, LAG(moved_at) OVER (PARTITION BY move_type ORDER BY moved_at, id) AS prev_moved_at
    FROM recent
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_moved_at IS NULL OR moved_at > prev_moved_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY move_type ORDER BY moved_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        move_type,
        burst_id,
        MIN(moved_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(moved_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(unit_price) AS session_unit_price,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(moved_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(moved_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY move_type, burst_id
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM per_session
    WHERE duration_min > (SELECT AVG(duration_min) FROM per_session)
)
SELECT
    move_type,
    burst_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    events,
    session_unit_price,
    duration_min,
    DATE_FORMAT(session_start, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS session_start_label
FROM without_matches
ORDER BY burst_id DESC NULLS FIRST, move_type
LIMIT 20

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent = (
    df_stock_moves
    .select(
        "id",
        "warehouse_id",
        "sku_id",
        "move_type",
        "moved_at",
        "unit_price",
    )
)

with_prev = recent.withColumn("prev_moved_at", F.lag("moved_at").over(Window.partitionBy("move_type").orderBy("moved_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_moved_at").isNull() | (F.col("moved_at") > F.col("prev_moved_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("move_type").orderBy("moved_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("move_type", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("moved_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("moved_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.sum("unit_price").alias("session_unit_price"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("moved_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("moved_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

without_matches = (
    per_session
    .crossJoin(per_session.agg(F.avg("duration_min").alias("overall_avg_duration_min")))
    .filter(F.col("duration_min") > F.col("overall_avg_duration_min"))
    .drop("overall_avg_duration_min")
)

result = (
    without_matches
    .select(
        "move_type",
        "burst_id",
        "session_start",
        "session_end",
        "events",
        "session_unit_price",
        "duration_min",
        F.date_format(F.col("session_start"), "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("session_start_label"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("burst_id").desc_nulls_first(), "move_type")
    .limit(20)
)

```sql
WITH gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time ASC, id ASC) IS NULL
                 OR txn_time > LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time ASC, id ASC) + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM transactions
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        is_flagged,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM gaps
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN amount >= 3000 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS amount_tier,
    MIN(txn_time) AS first_seen,
    AVG(amount) FILTER (WHERE txn_type = 'FEE') AS fee_avg_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(txn_type)) AS txn_type_list,
    COUNT_IF(txn_type = 'REFUND') AS refund_events,
    AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
FROM islands
GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount >= 3000 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
ORDER BY refund_events DESC;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

gaps = (
    df_transactions
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "is_flagged",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("island_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    islands
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 3000, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("amount_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("txn_time").alias("first_seen"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "FEE", F.col("amount"))).alias("fee_avg_amount"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("txn_type")).alias("txn_type_list"),
        F.count_if(F.col("txn_type") == "REFUND").alias("refund_events"),
        F.avg("amount").alias("avg_amount"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("refund_events").desc())
)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("promotion_discount_pct", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)

attributed = (
    df_promotions
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("a.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & (F.col("a.starts_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("a.starts_on") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(

        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("unit_price", "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("row_seq", "id")
w_hist = Window.orderBy(F.col("unit_price_bucket").desc(), "id")

scored = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([16, 23, 27, 39]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "unit_price",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc_nulls_last())).alias("unit_price_cume_dist"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("unit_price", "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.lead("quantity", 1).over(w_part).alias("next_quantity"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "unit_price",
        "unit_price_cume_dist",
        "next_quantity",
        F.lead("next_quantity").over(w_ordered).alias("next_next_quantity"),
        F.lag("unit_price_cume_dist").over(w_ordered).alias("prev_unit_price_cume_dist"),
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("seq_no"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id").orderBy("unit_price", "id")).alias("unit_price_bucket"),
    )
)

scored_order_items = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("seq_no_2", F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("prev_unit_price_cume_dist", "id")))
    .withColumn("unit_price_bucket_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w_hist))
)

base = (
    scored_order_items
    .filter(F.col("next_next_quantity") == 6)
    .select(
        "id",
        "unit_price",
        "unit_price_cume_dist",
        "next_next_quantity",
        "prev_unit_price_cume_dist",
        "seq_no",
        "seq_no_2",
        "unit_price_bucket_bucket",
        F.floor("next_quantity").alias("next_quantity_whole"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "unit_price",
        "unit_price_cume_dist",
        "prev_unit_price_cume_dist",
        "seq_no_2",
        "unit_price_bucket_bucket",
        "next_quantity_whole",
        F.avg("unit_price").over(Window.orderBy("next_quantity_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_avg_unit_price"),
        F.sum("unit_price").over(Window.orderBy("next_quantity_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_unit_price"),
        F.count("unit_price").over(Window.orderBy("next_quantity_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_unit_price"),
        F.max("unit_price").over(Window.orderBy("next_quantity_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_max_unit_price"),
    )
)

enriched_order_items = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("running_max_unit_price_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("running_max_unit_price").desc_nulls_last())))
    .withColumn("next_seq_no_2", F.lead("seq_no_2", 1).over(Window.orderBy("next_quantity_whole", "id")))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("running_sum_unit_price").desc(), "id")))
    .withColumn("prev_unit_price", F.lag("unit_price", 2, 0).over(Window.orderBy("seq_no_2", "id")))
    .withColumn("prev_unit_price_cume_dist_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("prev_unit_price_cume_dist").desc(), "id")))
)

cleaned = (
    enriched_order_items
    .filter(F.col("running_max_unit_price_cume_dist") <= 0.39)
    .withColumn("unit_price_minus_unit_price_cume_dist", (F.col("unit_price") - F.col("unit_price_cume_dist")))
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("running_max_unit_price_cume_dist") >= 0.78, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("running_max_unit_price_cume_dist_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("running_max_unit_price_cume_dist", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("running_max_unit_price_cume_dist_quartiles"),
        F.sum("unit_price_cume_dist").alias("total_unit_price_cume_dist"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),

),
base AS (

),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        service,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        attr_key_length,
        clean_service,
        attr_key_filled,
        CASE WHEN service = 'billing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_billing
    FROM base
    WHERE status_code_rounded BETWEEN 54 AND 71
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN status_code >= 405 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS status_code_tier,
    CASE WHEN is_billing >= 63 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS is_billing_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(attr_key_length, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS attr_key_length_quartiles,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT service) AS distinct_services
FROM cleaned
GROUP BY status_code_tier, is_billing_tier
ORDER BY event_count

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("attr_key", "v"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms").between(1096, 1514))
    .select(
        "service",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        F.length("attr_key").alias("attr_key_length"),
        F.trim("service").alias("clean_service"),
        F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("NONE")).alias("attr_key_clean"),
    )

base = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("attr_key_length") <= 38)
    .withColumn("status_code_rounded", F.round("status_code", 2))
    .withColumn("attr_key_filled", F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("DIRECT")))
)

cleaned = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("status_code_rounded").between(54, 71))
    .select(
        "service",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        "attr_key_length",
        "clean_service",
        "attr_key_filled",
        F.when(F.col("service") == "billing", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_billing"),
    )
)

result = (

    .groupBy(

        is_new_session,

    FROM sessionized

        AVG(quantity_minus_line_total) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS quantity_minus_line_total_avg_3_prior,
        FIRST_VALUE(adjusted_quantity) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY line_total_int, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_adjusted_quantity
    FROM base
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.order_id,
        s.product_id,
        s.quantity,
        s.line_total,
        s.line_total_int,
        s.event_seq,
        s.quantity_minus_line_total_avg_3_prior,
        p.category
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN products p

),
with_dims AS (

        e.id,
        e.product_id,
        e.line_total,
        e.line_total_int,

        d.brand,

    (SELECT MAX(i2.quantity) FROM inventory i2 WHERE i2.product_id = s.product_id) AS max_inventory_quantity
FROM with_dims s

        "product_id",
        "quantity",

        F.round((F.col("unit_price") / F.col("quantity")), 2).alias("line_total"),
        F.round((F.col("quantity") * 100), 2).alias("adjusted_quantity"),

    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())

        (F.col("quantity") - F.col("line_total")).alias("quantity_minus_line_total"),
        F.col("line_total").cast("int").alias("line_total_int"),
    )

scored = (

    .withColumn("quantity_minus_line_total_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity_minus_line_total", "id")))

        "e.product_id",
        "e.line_total",
        "e.line_total_int",
        "e.event_seq",
        F.col("d.brand"),

    .withColumn("city_prefix", F.substring("city", 1, 4))

ranked = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("region", "city").orderBy("sqft")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

with_latest = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.units").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(

        "s.years_since_opened_date",

        "store_sale_revenue",

        F.last("store_sale_revenue", ignorenulls=True).over(w_recent).alias("last_known_store_sale_revenue"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("years_since_opened_date") >= 72, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("years_since_opened_date_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("last_known_store_sale_revenue") >= 4200, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("last_known_store_sale_revenue_tier"),

    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),

    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        student_id,
        session_no,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(enrolled_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY student_id, session_no
)
SELECT
    student_id,
    session_no,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    n_events,
    GREATEST(session_no, duration_min) AS greatest_session_no_duration_min,
    session_no - n_events AS session_no_minus_n_events
FROM sessions
ORDER BY session_end DESC NULLS FIRST, student_id, session_no
LIMIT 5

    df_enrollments
    .select(

        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",

)

    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_enrolled_at").isNull() | (F.col("enrolled_at") > F.col("prev_enrolled_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))

sessions = (

    .groupBy("student_id", "session_no")
    .agg(
        F.min("enrolled_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("enrolled_at").alias("session_end"),

        F.lead("closed_at").over(w_all_by_opened_at).alias("next_closed_at"),

    FROM scoped
    WINDOW w_all_by_read_at AS (ORDER BY read_at ASC, id)
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        read_at,
        quality_len,
        next_quality_len,
        kwh_bucket_change,
        FLOOR(kwh_bucket / 25) * 25 AS kwh_bucket_bucket,
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', next2_read_at) AS next2_read_at_hour,

    FROM sequenced

filtered AS (

    WHERE quality_len > (SELECT AVG(quality_len) FROM tagged)

    ROUND(AVG(next_quality_len), 2) AS avg_next_quality_len,

FROM filtered

    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= F.lit("2023-04-02").cast("date"))
    .select(

        "quantity",

    .filter(F.month("last_restock_plus_58d").isin([3, 7, 8]))

        "product_id",
        "quantity",

    FROM filtered s

annotated AS (
    -- Derive helper columns

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

enriched = (
    df_stores
    .filter(~F.col("city").isin(["Singapore", "Chiang Mai"]))
    .withColumn("running_sqft", F.sum("sqft").over(Window.orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("sqft_avg_6", F.avg("sqft").over(Window.orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("cumulative_sqft", F.sum("sqft").over(Window.orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc(), "id")))
)

ranked = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("sqft_avg_6").asc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "opened_date",
        "sqft",
        "running_sqft",
        "sqft_avg_6",
        "cumulative_sqft",

        F.sum("seq_no").over(Window.orderBy("running_sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_seq_no"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc(), "id")).alias("sqft_bucket"),
    )
)

    metrics
    .alias("s")

    FROM with_details_holder
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT

    GROUPING_ID() AS gid,

),

    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'Unknown') AS attr_key_filled,
        CONCAT(service, ' ', attr_key) AS service_attr_key
    FROM metrics
    WHERE attr_key IS NOT NULL
      AND log_ts > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 07:00:00'
),
scored AS (

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy(F.year("log_ts"), "service").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "attr_key")
w_grp_2 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("log_ts"), "attr_key").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy(F.year("log_ts"), "attr_key").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "value"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    flattened
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "attr_key",
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp_2).alias("event_seq_2"),
        F.last("attr_key", ignorenulls=True).over(w_recent).alias("last_known_attr_key"),
    )
)

base = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull() & (F.col("log_ts") > F.lit("2025-06-01 07:00:00").cast("timestamp")))
    .withColumn("attr_key_filled", F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("Unknown")))
    .withColumn("service_attr_key", F.concat("service", F.lit(" "), "attr_key"))
)

scored = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("event_seq_2") < 5)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("event_seq").asc_nulls_last())).alias("event_seq_cume_dist"),
        F.round((F.col("event_seq") / F.sum("event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("log_ts"), "attr_key"))), 4).alias("event_seq_share"),
        F.stddev_samp("event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "log_ts"), "attr_key")).alias("log_ts_period_stddev_samp_event_seq"),
        F.round((F.col("event_seq") / F.sum("event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "log_ts"), "attr_key"))), 4).alias("event_seq_share_2"),
        F.count("event_seq_2").over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key")).alias("attr_key_count_event_seq_2"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    scored
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("service", "attr_key").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

result = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("activity_day", F.date_trunc("DAY", "log_ts"))
    .withColumn("log_ts_period_stddev_samp_event_seq_tier", F.when(F.col("log_ts_period_stddev_samp_event_seq") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["activity_day", "log_ts_period_stddev_samp_event_seq_tier"], ["activity_day"], []],
        "activity_day",
        "log_ts_period_stddev_samp_event_seq_tier",

    .agg(
        F.min("log_ts").alias("started_at"),
        F.max("log_ts").alias("ended_at"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_id"),
    )

    FROM scoped

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (

        session_id,
        MIN(opened_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(opened_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(opened_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(opened_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY agent_id, session_id

ticket_stats AS (

    SELECT

        SUM(csat) AS total_ticket_csat,
        MIN(opened_at) AS first_ticket_opened_at
    FROM tickets
    GROUP BY agent_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach tickets metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        t.total_ticket_csat,
        t.first_ticket_opened_at
    FROM per_session s
    LEFT JOIN ticket_stats t ON t.agent_id = s.agent_id

    n_events,
    agent_id,
    MAX(first_ticket_opened_at) AS last_first_ticket_opened_at,
    COUNT(*) AS n_rows,

        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "opened_at",
        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "csat",
        "tags",
    )
)

with_prev = scoped.withColumn("prev_opened_at", F.lag("opened_at").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id").orderBy("opened_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_opened_at").isNull() | (F.col("opened_at") > F.col("prev_opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id").orderBy("opened_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (

    .groupBy("agent_id", "session_id")

WITH prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) AS prev_paid_at
    FROM payments
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_paid_at IS NULL OR paid_at > prev_paid_at + INTERVAL '60' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM prev_events
),
sessions_payments AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM gaps
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.order_id,
    s.method,
    s.paid_at,
    s.status,
    s.prev_paid_at,
    s.new_group_flag,
    CASE WHEN method RLIKE '^(paypal|card)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS method_zone,
    (SELECT SUM(t2.cost) FROM shipments t2 WHERE t2.order_id = s.order_id) AS sum_shipment_cost
FROM sessions_payments s
ORDER BY method_zone DESC, sum_shipment_cost

    prev_events
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_paid_at").isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.col("prev_paid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_payments = gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

        LAG(country_stddev_samp_is_active, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY monthly_fee, id) AS prev_country_stddev_samp_is_active,
        FIRST_VALUE(is_active_rank) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY country_stddev_samp_is_active, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_is_active_rank,

    FROM with_windows
    WHERE monthly_fee >= 70
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    c.segment,
    s.status,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
    ROUND(SUM(s.is_active), 2) AS total_is_active,
    GROUPING_ID() AS level_id
FROM with_windows_subscriptions s
LEFT JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY CUBE (c.segment, s.status)

    amount,

            FROM payments c

            ORDER BY c.paid_at DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1

    )
)

cleaned = (
    flattened
    .filter((F.col("log_ts") < "2024-01-01") & F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())
    .select(

        "log_ts",
        "level",

deduped = (

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base_listeners = (
    df_listeners
    .filter(F.col("signup_date").between(F.lit("2024-08-02").cast("date"), F.lit("2025-05-05").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "username",
        "country",
        "signup_date",
        "birth_year",
        "interests",
        F.date_format(F.col("signup_date"), "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("signup_date_label"),
        F.when(F.col("country").isin("BR", "TH"), "group_a").when(F.col("country") == "JP", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("country_group"),
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("signup_date")).alias("days_since_signup_date"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    base_listeners
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("country_group", F.date_trunc("month", "signup_date"))).alias("rows_in_country_group_signup_date_month"),
        F.round(F.avg("days_since_signup_date").over(Window.orderBy("signup_date", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("days_since_signup_date_avg_3"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy("signup_date")).alias("signup_date_dense_rank"),
    )
)

with_trends = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rows_in_country_group_signup_date_month")), 3).alias("rows_in_country_group_signup_date_month_cume_dis"),
        F.max("birth_year").over(Window.partitionBy("country_group").orderBy("birth_year", "id").rowsBetween(-1, Window.currentRow)).alias("birth_year_max_2"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("signup_date_dense_rank", "country").orderBy(F.col("days_since_signup_date_avg_3").asc_nulls_last(), "id")).alias("days_since_signup_date_avg_3_quintile"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("country_group").orderBy("birth_year", "id")).alias("birth_year_quintile"),
    )
)

with_trends_2 = (
    with_trends
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("days_since_signup_date_avg_3", 3).over(Window.partitionBy("birth_year_quintile").orderBy("days_since_signup_date_avg_3_quintile", "id")).alias("prev3_days_since_signup_date_avg_3"),
        F.max("days_since_signup_date_avg_3").over(Window.partitionBy("birth_year_quintile").orderBy(F.col("birth_year").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("days_since_signup_date_avg_3_max_6_prior"),
        F.last("birth_year_max_2", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("birth_year_quintile").orderBy(F.col("birth_year").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_birth_year_max_2"),

)

    with_trends_2
    .groupBy(
        "birth_year_quintile",
        F.date_format("signup_date", "yyyy-MM").alias("signup_date_ym"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("days_since_signup_date_avg_3_max_6_prior"), 2).alias("total_days_since_signup_date_avg_3_max_6_prior"),

)

    .select(
        "*",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("signup_date_ym")), 1, 3).alias("signup_date_ym_prefix"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("signup_date_ym")), 1, 4).alias("signup_date_ym_prefix_2"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("birth_year_quintile"), F.lit(0)).alias("birth_year_quintile_filled"),
    )
)

result = (

    .select(

        "signup_date_ym",
        "total_days_since_signup_date_avg_3_max_6_prior",
        "avg_days_since_signup_date_avg_3_quintile",
        "signup_date_ym_prefix_2",
        "birth_year_quintile_filled",
        F.concat_ws("-", F.col("signup_date_ym"), F.col("signup_date_ym_prefix")).alias("signup_date_ym_signup_date_ym_prefix_label"),
    )

WITH recent_readings AS (
    -- Filter meter_readings
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        quality,
        ROUND(kwh / NULLIF(voltage, 0), 3) AS kwh_per_voltage
    FROM meter_readings
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous read_at per quality
    SELECT *, LAG(read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY quality ORDER BY read_at, id) AS prev_read_at
    FROM recent_readings
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_read_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(read_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_read_at)) / 60 > 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY quality ORDER BY read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        quality,
        session_id,
        MIN(read_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(read_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY quality, session_id
)
SELECT
    quality,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    n_events,
    duration_min,
    CASE WHEN quality IN ('BAD', 'OK') THEN 'group_a' WHEN quality = 'EST' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS quality_group,
    GREATEST(duration_min, n_events) AS greatest_duration_min_n_events
FROM sessions
ORDER BY duration_min
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent_readings = (
    df_meter_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "quality",
        F.round(F.col("kwh") / F.nullif(F.col("voltage"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("kwh_per_voltage"),
    )
)

with_prev = recent_readings.withColumn("prev_read_at", F.lag("read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy("read_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_read_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("read_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_read_at")) / 60 > 45), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("quality", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("read_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("read_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("read_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("read_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessions
    .select(
        "quality",
        "session_id",
        "session_start",
        "n_events",
        "duration_min",
        F.when(F.col("quality").isin("BAD", "OK"), "group_a").when(F.col("quality") == "EST", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("quality_group"),
        F.greatest(F.col("duration_min"), F.col("n_events")).alias("greatest_duration_min_n_events"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("duration_min").asc())
)
```

    FROM cleaned_policys

    SELECT *
    FROM windowed
    WHERE premium_vs_status_avg > (SELECT MIN(premium_vs_status_avg) FROM windowed)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.orderBy("seq_no", "id")

deduped = (
    df_promotions
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("starts_on").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "starts_on", "ends_on", "discount_pct")
)

scored = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("discount_pct").between(0.2, 0.29))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("discount_pct").over(Window.orderBy("ends_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_discount_pct"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("ends_on", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

scored_promotions = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "running_discount_pct",
        F.lead("running_discount_pct").over(w_part).alias("next_running_discount_pct"),
        F.lag("running_discount_pct").over(w_part).alias("prev_running_discount_pct"),
        F.lag("discount_pct").over(w_part).alias("prev_discount_pct"),
        F.lead("discount_pct").over(w_part).alias("next_discount_pct"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored_promotions
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("running_discount_pct").desc(), "id")).alias("running_discount_pct_bucket"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("event_seq").desc())).alias("event_seq_cume_dist"),
    )
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter((F.col("ends_on") >= F.lit("2023-08-17").cast("date")) & F.col("prev_discount_pct").between(0.12, 0.28))
    .select(
        "id",
        "ends_on",
        "running_discount_pct",
        "next_running_discount_pct",
        "prev_running_discount_pct",
        "prev_discount_pct",
        "next_discount_pct",
        "event_seq",
        "running_discount_pct_bucket",
        "event_seq_cume_dist",
        (F.col("event_seq_cume_dist") - F.col("running_discount_pct_bucket")).alias("event_seq_cume_dist_minus_running_discount_pct_bucket"),
    )
)

base_promotions = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("ends_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-07-09")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("prev_running_discount_pct") / F.col("next_running_discount_pct")), 2).alias("prev_running_discount_pct_per_next_running_discount_pct"),
    )
)

result = (
    base_promotions
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("next_discount_pct") >= 0.29, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("next_discount_pct_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("next_running_discount_pct"), 2).alias("avg_next_running_discount_pct"),
        F.round(F.avg("prev_running_discount_pct_per_next_running_discount_pct"), 2).alias("avg_prev_running_discount_pct_per_next_running_discount_pct"),
        F.percentile_approx("event_seq", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("event_seq_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("running_discount_pct_bucket", 0.95).alias("running_discount_pct_bucket_p95"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_2"),

        F.date_format(F.col("signup_date"), "MMM yyyy").alias("signup_date_label"),
    )
)

w_country_by_birth_year_ties = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("birth_year").desc())
w_plan_country = Window.partitionBy("plan", "country")
w_country_by_birth_year = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("birth_year").desc(), "id")
w_all_by_signup_date = Window.orderBy("signup_date", "id")
sequenced = (

    .select(

        "country",
        "signup_date",
        "interests",

        F.rank().over(w_country_by_birth_year_ties).alias("birth_year_rank"),
        F.round(F.avg("birth_year").over(w_plan_country), 2).alias("plan_country_avg_birth_year"),
        F.sum("birth_year").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("birth_year").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_birth_year"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("birth_year").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.orderBy("signup_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_2"),
        F.row_number().over(w_country_by_birth_year).alias("rn"),
        (F.col("birth_year") - F.lag("birth_year").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("birth_year").desc(), "id"))).alias("birth_year_change"),
        F.row_number().over(w_all_by_signup_date).alias("rn_2"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy("country", "plan").orderBy("signup_date", "id")).alias("signup_date_tercile"),
    )
)

labeled = (
    sequenced
    .filter(F.col("rn_2") <= 9)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2026-01-01").cast("date"), F.col("signup_date")).alias("days_since_signup_date"),
        (F.col("rn") + F.col("running_count_2")).alias("rn_plus_running_count_2"),
    )
)

w_all_by_birth_year_rank = Window.orderBy("birth_year_rank", "id")

    .withColumn("n_plan_not_in_free_family_share_of_distinct_plan", F.round(F.col("n_plan_not_in_free_family") / F.nullif(F.sum("n_plan_not_in_free_family").over(Window.partitionBy("distinct_plans")), F.lit(0)), 4))
    .withColumn("rn_2_vs_distinct_plans_avg", F.round(F.col("rn_2") - F.avg("rn_2").over(Window.partitionBy("distinct_plans")), 2))
)

result = (
    sequenced_2
    .select(
        "seq_no",
        "rn_2",
        "n_rows",
        "n_plan_not_in_free_family",
        "rn_2_vs_distinct_plans_avg",
        F.round(F.col("rn_2") / F.nullif(F.col("distinct_plans"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("rn_2_per_distinct_plans"),
    )
    .orderBy("seq_no")
)

        F.last("key", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "log_ts"), "service").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_key"),

    -- Scope the enrollments rows
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        grade_status,
        enrolled_at
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE course_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous enrolled_at per course_id
    SELECT *, LAG(enrolled_at) OVER (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id) AS prev_enrolled_at
    FROM scoped
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_enrolled_at IS NULL OR enrolled_at > prev_enrolled_at + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        course_id,
        session_no,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(enrolled_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY course_id, session_no
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach course attributes
    SELECT s.*, c.level AS course_level
    FROM per_session s
    JOIN courses c ON c.id = s.course_id
    WHERE c.level IN ('intro', 'core')
)
SELECT
    course_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    events,
    course_level,
    CASE WHEN course_level IN ('core', 'intro') THEN 'group_a' WHEN course_level = 'advanced' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS course_level_group
FROM joined
ORDER BY events DESC NULLS FIRST, session_start DESC NULLS FIRST

    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("course_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
    )
)

with_prev = scoped.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("course_id").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_enrolled_at").isNull() | (F.col("enrolled_at") > F.col("prev_enrolled_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

per_session = (

    .groupBy("course_id", "session_no")

        F.max("enrolled_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("enrolled_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("enrolled_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),

)

)

    FROM flagged

screened AS (

    agent_id,

    SELECT
        id,
        warehouse_id,
        sku_id,
        move_type,
        moved_at,
        operator,
        unit_price,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', move_type, operator) AS move_type_operator_label
    FROM stock_moves
    WHERE sku_id IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach sku attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.warehouse_id,
        s.sku_id,
        s.move_type,
        s.operator,
        s.unit_price,
        s.move_type_operator_label,
        sk.labels AS sku_labels,
        sk.unit_cost AS sku_unit_cost
    FROM valid s
    JOIN skus sk ON sk.id = s.sku_id
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY unit_price, id), 3) AS unit_price_percent_rank,
        MIN(sku_unit_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY operator) AS operator_min_sku_unit_cost,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sku_unit_cost, id) AS seq_no,
        ROUND(sku_unit_cost / NULLIF(SUM(sku_unit_cost) OVER w_operator, 0), 4) AS sku_unit_cost_share_of_operator,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(sku_id) OVER (PARTITION BY operator)) AS distinct_sku_id_in_operator,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(move_type) OVER (PARTITION BY operator)) AS distinct_move_type_in_operator,
        LAG(sku_unit_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY move_type ORDER BY sku_unit_cost ASC NULLS LAST, id) AS prev_sku_unit_cost,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY operator ORDER BY sku_unit_cost, id), 3) AS sku_unit_cost_cume_dist,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sku_id, move_type) AS rows_in_sku_id_move_type
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_operator AS (PARTITION BY operator)
),
enriched_2 AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN prev_sku_unit_cost >= 302.5 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN prev_sku_unit_cost >= 134.3 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS prev_sku_unit_cost_tier,
        COALESCE(move_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS move_type_or_unknown
    FROM with_trends
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        warehouse_id,
        sku_id,
        move_type,
        operator,
        unit_price,
        sku_labels,
        sku_unit_cost,
        unit_price_percent_rank,
        operator_min_sku_unit_cost,
        seq_no,
        sku_unit_cost_share_of_operator,
        distinct_sku_id_in_operator,
        sku_unit_cost_cume_dist,
        prev_sku_unit_cost_tier,
        move_type_or_unknown,

    FROM with_prev

    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY term_or_unknown ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (

    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY term_or_unknown, session_id
)

    SELECT term_or_unknown, session_id, duration_min, session_score
    FROM per_session

) unp

    .select("a.*", F.col("b.status"), F.col("b.account_type"), F.col("b.opened_date"))

with_dims = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("p"), F.col("s.account_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("p.account_type") == "SAVINGS")
    .select(

)

enriched = (

    FROM filtered

),
first_rows AS (

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (

WITH valid AS (

        read_at,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        FLOOR(kwh / 25) * 25 AS kwh_bucket
    FROM meter_readings
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous read_at per site_id
    SELECT *, LAG(read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY read_at, id) AS prev_read_at
    FROM valid
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_read_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(read_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_read_at)) / 60 > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        site_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(read_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(read_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(kwh_bucket) AS session_kwh_bucket,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY site_id, session_id
)
SELECT
    site_id,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    n_events,
    duration_min,
    ROUND(n_events / NULLIF(session_kwh_bucket, 0), 3) AS n_events_per_session_kwh_bucket,
    GREATEST(session_id, n_events) AS greatest_session_id_n_events
FROM sessions

valid = (
    df_meter_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        (F.floor(F.col("kwh") / 25) * 25).alias("kwh_bucket"),
    )
)

with_prev = valid.withColumn("prev_read_at", F.lag("read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("read_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_read_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("read_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_read_at")) / 60 > 30), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("site_id", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("read_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("read_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.sum("kwh_bucket").alias("session_kwh_bucket"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("read_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("read_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

        "session_id",
        "session_start",
        "session_end",
        "n_events",
        "duration_min",

    -- PAID rows per claim_date_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date) AS claim_date_month, COUNT(*) AS paid_count, ROUND(AVG(claimed_amount), 2) AS paid_avg_claimed_amount

rejected_monthly AS (

    FROM claims
    WHERE status = 'REJECTED'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.claim_date_month, b.claim_date_month) AS claim_date_month,
    COALESCE(a.paid_count, 0) AS paid_count,
    a.paid_avg_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(b.rejected_count, 0) AS rejected_count,
    b.rejected_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.paid_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.rejected_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM paid_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN rejected_monthly b
  ON a.claim_date_month = b.claim_date_month
ORDER BY claim_date_month

    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status") == "PAID")

rejected_monthly = (

    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date").alias("claim_date_month"))

    .select(

    FROM latest

    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)

    WHERE voltage >= 224.8

    FROM meter_readings
    GROUP BY site_id

        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, reading_count ORDER BY read_at ASC) AS read_at_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, reading_count ORDER BY read_at ASC, id) AS rn,

        SUM(kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY quality ORDER BY read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS kwh_sum_3_prior
    FROM profiled
),

    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.site_id,
        s.read_at,

        s.reading_count_share_of_reading_count,
